story.fr: La plateforme SnBr4 a été achevée. Le professeur Null a appuyé sur l'alarme au lieu du bouton de célébration.
story.zh: SnBr4装置组装完成。Null教授按下了警报按钮，而不是庆祝按钮。
story.it: La piattaforma SnBr4 è stata completata. Il professor Null ha premuto l'allarme invece del pulsante di celebrazione.
story.ko: SnBr4 장치를 완성했습니다. Null 교수는 축하 버튼 대신 경보 버튼을 눌렀습니다.
story.ru: Установка для получения SnBr4 была завершена. Профессор Нуль нажал на кнопку тревоги вместо кнопки празднования.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 3: HCl — Mantık rotası güçlendirildi — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: HCl laboratuvarı buharlandı. Dr. Edward Atom gözlüğünü silip “Plan buydu” dedi.
story.en: The HCl lab filled with vapor. Dr. Edward Atom wiped his glasses and said, “Exactly as planned.”
story.fr: Le laboratoire est rempli de vapeur. Dr. Edward Atom a essuyé ses lunettes et a dit,  Exactement comme prévu.
story.zh: 实验室充满了蒸汽。Dr. Edward Atom擦了他的眼镜说，正如计划。
story.it: Il laboratorio HCl riempito di vapore. Dr. Edward Atom ha asciugato i suoi occhiali e ha detto: “Esattamente come previsto.”
story.ko: HCl 연구실이 증기로 가득 찼습니다. Dr. Edward Atom은 안경을 닦으며 “정확히 계획대로군요.”라고 말했습니다.
story.ru: Лаборатория HCl наполнилась паром. Доктор Эдвард Атом протер очки и сказал: «Всё точно по плану».

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 4: AlBr3 — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: AlBr₃ kristali parladı. Null onu cebine koymayı denedi; cebinde delik açıldı.
story.en: The AlBr3 crystal glowed. Null tried to pocket it; it burned a hole through his coat.
story.fr: Le cristal AlBr3 brillait. Null a essayé de le mettre dans sa poche, il a brûlé un trou dans son manteau.
story.zh: "AlBr3晶体"发光了。Null试图把它放在口袋里，它烧了他的外套。
story.it: Il cristallo AlBr3 si guastava. Null cercò di intascarlo; bruciò un buco attraverso il suo cappotto.
story.ko: AlBr3 결정이 빛났습니다. Null이 몰래 챙기려다 실험복에 구멍이 났습니다.
story.ru: Кристалл AlBr3 засветился. Нуль попытался спрятать его в карман; он прожег дыру в его пальто.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 5: CaCl2 — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: CaCl₂ başarıyla kuruldu. Dr. Edward Atom Nobel konuşmasına yanlışlıkla yemek tarifi ekledi.
story.en: CaCl2 was assembled. Dr. Edward Atom accidentally added a recipe to his Nobel speech.
story.fr: CaCl2 a été assemblé. Dr. Edward Atom a accidentellement ajouté une recette à son discours Nobel.
story.zh: 已组装CaCl2. Dr. Edward Atom 在他的诺贝尔演讲中意外添加了一条食谱。
story.it: CaCl2 è stato assemblato. Dr. Edward Atom ha accidentalmente aggiunto una ricetta al suo discorso Nobel.
story.ko: CaCl₂가 완성되었습니다. Dr. Edward Atom은 실수로 노벨 연설문에 요리법을 하나 추가했습니다.
story.ru: Был синтезирован CaCl2. Доктор Эдвард Атом случайно добавил рецепт в свою Нобелевскую речь.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 6: BCl3 — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: BCl₃ deneyi bitti. Komite not aldı; Dr. Edward Atom notun üstüne yıldız çizdi.
story.en: The BCl3 experiment ended. The committee took notes; Dr. Edward Atom drew a star on them.
story.fr: L'expérience BCl3 est terminée. Le comité a pris des notes; Dr. Edward Atom a dessiné une étoile sur eux.
story.zh: BCl3实验结束了。委员会写了笔记，Dr. Edward Atom 画了一个星。
story.it: L'esperimento BCl3 si è concluso. Il comitato ha preso appunti; Dr. Edward Atom ha disegnato una stella su di loro.
story.ko: BCl3 실험이 끝났습니다. 위원회가 메모했고 Dr. Edward Atom은 그 위에 별을 그렸습니다.
story.ru: Эксперимент с BCl3 завершился. Комитет сделал записи; доктор Эдвард Атом отметил их звездочкой.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 7: S2F2 — Mantık rotası güçlendirildi — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: S₂F₂ reaktörü çalıştı. Null güvenlik kaskını ters takınca herkes daha güvende hissetti.
story.en: The S2F2 reactor worked. Null wore his safety helmet backwards, making everyone feel safer.
story.fr: Le réacteur S2F2 a fonctionné. Null portait son casque de sécurité à l'envers, ce qui rendait tout le monde plus en sécurité.
story.zh: S2F2反应堆正常运行。Null把安全帽戴反了，反而让所有人更有安全感。
story.it: Il reattore S2F2 ha funzionato. Null indossava il suo casco di sicurezza all'indietro, rendendo tutti più sicuri.
story.ko: S2F2 원자로가 작동했습니다. Null은 안전모를 거꾸로 써서 모두를 더 안심시켰습니다.
story.ru: Реактор S2F2 работал. Нуль надел защитный шлем задом наперёд, благодаря чему все чувствовали себя в большей безопасности.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 8: NH3 — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: NH₃ molekülü tamamlandı. Dr. Edward Atom kokuyu bilime, Null ise çoraplarına bağladı.
story.en: NH3 was complete. Dr. Edward Atom blamed science for the smell; Null blamed his socks.
story.fr: Le NH3 était terminé. Dr. Edward Atom a blâmé la science pour l'odeur; Null a blâmé ses chaussettes.
story.zh: NH3完成了。Dr. Edward Atom把气味归咎于科学；Null则怪自己的袜子。
story.it: NH3 era completo. Dr. Edward Atom incolpava la scienza per l'odore; Null incolpava i suoi calzini.
story.ko: NH3가 완성되었습니다. Dr. Edward Atom은 냄새를 과학 탓으로 돌렸고, Null은 자기 양말 탓으로 돌렸습니다.
story.ru: Образование аммиака было завершено. Доктор Эдвард Атом обвинил науку в запахе; Нуль обвинил свои носки.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 9: SiBr4 — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: SiBr₄ zinciri kilitlendi. Dr. Edward Atom “kusursuz” dedi; kapı kolu elinde kaldı.
story.en: The SiBr4 chain locked in place. Dr. Edward Atom said “perfect” as the door handle fell off.
story.fr: La chaîne SiBr₄ s’est verrouillée. Dr. Edward Atom a dit « parfait » au moment où la poignée de porte est tombée.
story.zh: "SiBr4"链锁定了位置。Dr. Edward Atom说"完美"当门柄掉下来。
story.it: La catena SiBr4 si bloccò in posizione. Dr. Edward Atom disse “perfetto” proprio mentre la maniglia della porta cadeva.
story.ko: SiBr4 사슬이 제자리에 고정되었습니다. Dr. Edward Atom이 “완벽해”라고 말하는 순간 문손잡이가 떨어졌습니다.
story.ru: Цепочка из SiBr4 зафиксировалась на месте. Доктор Эдвард Атом сказал «идеально», когда дверная ручка отвалилась.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 10: CS2 — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: CS₂ düzeneği hazır. Null gizli planını yüksek sesle okuyarak gizliliğini korudu.
story.en: The CS2 rig was ready. Null protected his secret plan by reading it aloud.
story.fr: La plateforme CS2 était prête. Null a protégé son plan secret en le lisant à haute voix.
story.zh: CS2平台已经准备好了。Null通过大声阅读保护了他的秘密计划。
story.it: La piattaforma CS2 era pronta. Null ha protetto il suo piano segreto leggendolo ad alta voce.
story.ko: CS2 장비가 준비되었습니다. Null은 비밀 계획을 소리 내어 읽으며 지키려 했습니다.
story.ru: Установка CS2 была готова. Нуль защитил свой секретный план, зачитав его вслух.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 11: NOCl — Gelişmiş mekanik sınavı

story.tr: NOCl sınavı geçti. Dr. Edward Atom komiteye el sallarken yanlış kameraya baktı.
story.en: The NOCl test passed. Dr. Edward Atom waved at the committee while looking into the wrong camera.
story.fr: Le test de NOCl a été passé. Dr. Edward Atom a fait signe au comité en regardant dans la mauvaise caméra.
story.zh: 经过了NOCl测试。Dr. Edward Atom在错误的摄像头中挥舞着委员会。
story.it: Il test di NOCl è passato. Dr. Edward Atom sventolava al comitato mentre cercava la telecamera sbagliata.
story.ko: NOCl 시험을 통과했습니다. Dr. Edward Atom은 엉뚱한 카메라를 보며 위원회에 손을 흔들었습니다.
story.ru: Тест на NOCl пройден успешно. Доктор Эдвард Атом помахал комитету рукой, глядя не в ту камеру.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 12: SnF4 — Portal, tek yön, kırılgan, bağlı atom ve basınç kapısı

story.tr: SnF₄ enerji hattı dengelendi. Null fişi çektiğini sandı; kendi tost makinesini kapattı.
story.en: The SnF4 energy line stabilized. Null thought he unplugged it; he had only switched off his toaster.
story.fr: La ligne d'énergie du SnF4 est stabilisée. Null pensait qu'il l'avait débranché; il avait seulement éteint son grille-pain.
story.zh: SnF4能量线稳定下来。Null以为自己拔掉了插头，其实只是关掉了烤面包机。
story.it: La linea di energia SnF4 si è stabilizzata. Null pensava che l'avesse scollegato; aveva spento solo il tostapane.
story.ko: SnF4 에너지 선이 안정되었습니다. Null은 플러그를 뽑았다고 생각했지만 토스터 전원만 껐습니다.
story.ru: Линия электропитания SnF4 стабилизировалась. Нуль думал, что отключил её от сети; на самом деле он просто выключил тостер.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 13: C2H4 — Portal, tek yön, kırılgan atom ve hareketli duvar

story.tr: C₂H₄ Grand Master düzeni tamamlandı. Dr. Edward Atom Nobel ceketiyle laboratuvar önlüğünü aynı anda giydi.
story.en: The C2H4 Grand Master layout was solved. Dr. Edward Atom wore his Nobel jacket over his lab coat.
story.fr: Le plan du Grand Maître C2H4 a été résolu. Dr. Edward Atom portait sa veste Nobel sur son manteau de laboratoire.
story.zh: C2H4大师布局已经解决了。Dr. Edward Atom 他在实验室外套上戴着诺贝尔的克。
story.it: Il layout C2H4 Gran Maestro è stato risolto. Dr. Edward Atom indossava la sua giacca Nobel sopra il suo cappotto di laboratorio.
story.ko: C2H4 그랜드 마스터 배치를 해결했습니다. Dr. Edward Atom은 실험복 위에 노벨 재킷을 입었습니다.
story.ru: Разгадана схема расположения атомов C2H4. Доктор Эдвард Атом надел свой нобелевский пиджак поверх лабораторного халата.

campaign.lesson: Grand Master 14: HOF — Portal, tek yön, kırılgan atom ve çekiç seçeneği

story.tr: HOF son prova başarıyla bitti. Dr. Edward Atom ve Null, 301. kapının önünde aynı anda “Ben hazırım” dedi.
story.en: The HOF final rehearsal succeeded. At the door to level 301, Dr. Edward Atom and Null both said, “I am ready.”
story.fr: La répétition finale de HOF réussit. Devant la porte du niveau 301, Dr. Edward Atom et Null dirent ensemble : « Je suis prêt. »
story.zh: HOF最终演练成功了。在第301关门前，Dr. Edward Atom和Null同时说道：“我准备好了。”
story.it: La prova finale dell'Albo d'oro riuscì. Davanti alla porta del livello 301, Dr. Edward Atom e Null dissero insieme: “Sono pronto.”
story.ko: HOF 최종 리허설이 성공했습니다. 레벨 301 문 앞에서 Dr. Edward Atom과 Null은 동시에 “준비됐어.”라고 말했습니다.
story.ru: Финальная репетиция Зала славы прошла успешно. У дверей 301-го этажа доктор Эдвард Атом и Нуль оба сказали: «Я готов».

campaign.lesson: Nobel Finali — portal, tek yön, ateş/don, hareketli duvar ve basınç kapısı

story.tr: Son molekül tamamlandı. Nobel Komitesi ayağa kalktı; Dr. Edward Atom bu kez telefonu kapatmadı. Nobel Ödülü artık senin!
story.en: The final molecule was complete. The Nobel Committee rose to its feet; this time Dr. Edward Atom did not hang up. The Nobel Prize is yours!
story.fr: La dernière molécule était complète. Le Comité Nobel s'est levé; cette fois Dr. Edward Atom n'a pas raccroché. Le prix Nobel est à vous!
story.zh: 最终分子完成了。诺贝尔委员会全体起立；这一次Dr. Edward Atom没有挂断电话。诺贝尔奖属于你！
story.it: La molecola finale era completa. Il Comitato Nobel si alzò in piedi; questa volta Dr. Edward Atom non chiuse la chiamata. Il Premio Nobel è tuo!
story.ko: 마지막 분자가 완성되었습니다. 노벨 위원회가 자리에서 일어섰고, 이번에는 Dr. Edward Atom이 전화를 끊지 않았습니다. 노벨상은 교수님의 것입니다!
story.ru: Последняя молекула была готова. Нобелевский комитет встал; на этот раз доктор Эдвард Атом не повесил трубку. Нобелевская премия ваша!

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 1: trace the distant X Signal through a calibrated portal without prescribing a single solution path.

story.tr: Nobel kutlamasının ardından kedinin kolyesi iki kez parladı. Uzak X Sinyali, kapalı bir portal hattını Rezonans Kasası’na doğru işaret ediyor.
story.en: After the Nobel celebration, the cat’s pendant flashed twice. The distant X Signal points through a dormant portal line toward the Resonance Vault.
story.de: Nach der Nobel-Feier blinkte der Anhänger der Katze zweimal. Das ferne X-Signal weist durch eine stillgelegte Portalstrecke zum Resonanz-Tresor.
story.es: Tras la celebración del Nobel, el colgante del gato brilló dos veces. La lejana Señal X apunta a través de una línea de portales inactiva hacia la Bóveda de Resonancia.
story.pt: Depois da celebração do Nobel, o pingente do gato brilhou duas vezes. O distante Sinal X aponta por uma linha de portais inativa até a Câmara de Ressonância.
story.ja: ノーベル賞の祝賀後、ネコのペンダントが二度光った。遠方のXシグナルは、休止中のポータル回線の先にある共鳴保管庫を示している。
story.fr: Après la célébration du Nobel, le pendentif du chat clignota deux fois. Le lointain Signal X indique une ligne de portails inactive menant à la Chambre de Résonance.
story.zh: 诺贝尔庆祝结束后，猫的吊坠连续闪了两次。遥远的X信号指向一条休眠的传送门线路，通往共振库。
story.it: Dopo la celebrazione del Nobel, il pendente del gatto lampeggiò due volte. Il lontano Segnale X indica una linea di portali inattiva diretta verso la Camera di Risonanza.
story.ko: After the Nobel celebration, the cat’s pendant flashed twice. The distant X Signal points through a dormant portal line toward the Resonance Vault.
story.ru: After the Nobel celebration, the cat’s pendant flashed twice. The distant X Signal points through a dormant portal line toward the Resonance Vault.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 2: read the directional phase field and assemble HOCl without a prescribed solution route.

story.tr: İlk koordinat kilitlendiğinde ikinci X darbesi yön değiştirdi. Eski tek yönlü alanlardan biri yeniden etkinleşti; Rezonans Kasası’na giden iz artık yalnızca konumu değil, yönü de tarif ediyor.
story.en: When the first coordinate locked, the second X pulse changed direction. An old one-way field came back online; the trace toward the Resonance Vault now describes not only a position, but a direction.
story.de: Als die erste Koordinate verriegelt war, änderte der zweite X-Impuls seine Richtung. Ein altes Einwegfeld wurde wieder aktiv; die Spur zum Resonanz-Tresor beschreibt nun nicht nur einen Ort, sondern auch eine Richtung.
story.es: Cuando se fijó la primera coordenada, el segundo pulso X cambió de dirección. Un antiguo campo unidireccional volvió a activarse; el rastro hacia la Bóveda de Resonancia ahora indica no solo una posición, sino también una dirección.
story.pt: Quando a primeira coordenada foi fixada, o segundo pulso X mudou de direção. Um antigo campo unidirecional voltou a funcionar; o rastro até a Câmara de Ressonância agora indica não apenas uma posição, mas também uma direção.
story.ja: 最初の座標が固定されると、第二のXパルスは向きを変えた。古い一方向フィールドが再起動し、共鳴保管庫への軌跡は位置だけでなく方向まで示し始めた。
story.fr: Lorsque la première coordonnée fut verrouillée, la seconde impulsion X changea de direction. Un ancien champ à sens unique se réactiva ; la trace vers la Chambre de Résonance indique désormais non seulement une position, mais aussi une direction.
story.zh: 第一个坐标锁定后，第二次X脉冲改变了方向。一处旧的单向场重新启动；通往共振库的轨迹现在不仅给出位置，也给出了方向。
story.it: Quando la prima coordinata fu bloccata, il secondo impulso X cambiò direzione. Un vecchio campo a senso unico tornò attivo; la traccia verso la Camera di Risonanza ora indica non solo una posizione, ma anche una direzione.
story.ko: When the first coordinate locked, the second X pulse changed direction. An old one-way field came back online; the trace toward the Resonance Vault now describes not only a position, but a direction.
story.ru: When the first coordinate locked, the second X pulse changed direction. An old one-way field came back online; the trace toward the Resonance Vault now describes not only a position, but a direction.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 3: fragile-atom discipline.

story.tr: HOCl imzası doğrulanınca kasadan ince bir yankı döndü. Sinyal, eski bir rezonans kristalini kararsızlaştırmıştı; NaBr izi ancak kırılgan parçayı gereksiz yere zorlamadan okunabilirdi.
story.en: When the HOCl signature was verified, a thin echo returned from the vault. The signal had destabilized an old resonance crystal; the NaBr trace could be read only without stressing the fragile piece unnecessarily.
story.de: Als die HOCl-Signatur bestätigt war, kam ein feines Echo aus dem Tresor zurück. Das Signal hatte einen alten Resonanzkristall destabilisiert; die NaBr-Spur ließ sich nur lesen, ohne das zerbrechliche Teil unnötig zu belasten.
story.es: Cuando se verificó la firma de HOCl, un eco tenue regresó de la bóveda. La señal había desestabilizado un antiguo cristal de resonancia; la traza de NaBr solo podía leerse sin forzar innecesariamente la pieza frágil.
story.pt: Quando a assinatura de HOCl foi confirmada, um eco fino voltou da câmara. O sinal havia desestabilizado um antigo cristal de ressonância; o rastro de NaBr só podia ser lido sem forçar desnecessariamente a peça frágil.
story.ja: HOClシグネチャが確認されると、保管庫から細い反響が返ってきた。シグナルは古い共鳴結晶を不安定にしており、NaBrの痕跡は壊れやすい部分に余計な負荷をかけずに読み取る必要があった。
story.fr: Une fois la signature HOCl validée, un faible écho revint de la chambre. Le signal avait déstabilisé un ancien cristal de résonance ; la trace NaBr ne pouvait être lue qu’en évitant de solliciter inutilement la pièce fragile.
story.zh: HOCl特征确认后，共振库传回了一道微弱回声。信号让一块旧共振晶体变得不稳定；只有避免不必要地挤压脆弱部件，才能读取NaBr轨迹。
story.it: Quando la firma HOCl fu verificata, dalla camera tornò un’eco sottile. Il segnale aveva destabilizzato un vecchio cristallo di risonanza; la traccia NaBr poteva essere letta solo senza stressare inutilmente il frammento fragile.
story.ko: When the HOCl signature was verified, a thin echo returned from the vault. The signal had destabilized an old resonance crystal; the NaBr trace could be read only without stressing the fragile piece unnecessarily.
story.ru: Когда сигнатура HOCl была подтверждена, из хранилища вернулось слабое эхо. Сигнал дестабилизировал старый резонансный кристалл; след NaBr можно было считать, только не подвергая хрупкую часть лишней нагрузке.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 4: one-way HOBr phase corridor.

story.tr: NaBr yankısından sonra kasanın dış halkasında tek yönlü bir faz koridoru açıldı. HOBr imzası koridorun akışını sabitliyordu; yanlış yöndeki kestirmeler kendiliğinden kapanıyordu.
story.en: After the NaBr echo, a one-way phase corridor opened on the vault’s outer ring. The HOBr signature stabilized its flow; shortcuts in the wrong direction closed by themselves.
story.de: Nach dem NaBr-Echo öffnete sich am äußeren Ring des Tresors ein Einweg-Phasenkorridor. Die HOBr-Signatur stabilisierte seinen Fluss; Abkürzungen in die falsche Richtung schlossen sich von selbst.
story.es: Tras el eco de NaBr, se abrió un corredor de fase unidireccional en el anillo exterior de la bóveda. La firma de HOBr estabilizaba su flujo; los atajos en dirección incorrecta se cerraban solos.
story.pt: Após o eco de NaBr, um corredor de fase unidirecional se abriu no anel externo da câmara. A assinatura de HOBr estabilizava o fluxo; atalhos na direção errada se fechavam sozinhos.
story.ja: NaBrの反響の後、保管庫の外周に一方向の位相回廊が開いた。HOBrシグネチャが流れを安定させ、逆方向の近道は自動的に閉じていった。
story.fr: Après l’écho NaBr, un couloir de phase à sens unique s’ouvrit sur l’anneau extérieur de la chambre. La signature HOBr stabilisait son flux ; les raccourcis dans le mauvais sens se refermaient d’eux-mêmes.
story.zh: NaBr回声之后，共振库外环开启了一条单向相位走廊。HOBr特征稳定了其中的流动；逆向捷径会自行关闭。
story.it: Dopo l’eco NaBr, sull’anello esterno della camera si aprì un corridoio di fase a senso unico. La firma HOBr ne stabilizzava il flusso; le scorciatoie nella direzione sbagliata si chiudevano da sole.
story.ko: After the NaBr echo, a one-way phase corridor opened on the vault’s outer ring. The HOBr signature stabilized its flow; shortcuts in the wrong direction closed by themselves.
story.ru: После эха NaBr на внешнем кольце хранилища открылся односторонний фазовый коридор. Сигнатура HOBr стабилизировала поток; короткие пути в неверном направлении закрывались сами.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 5: first Molecular Fusion. Assemble two valid HO/OH sub-structures anywhere, then slide the rigid groups together to complete H2O2 anywhere on the board.

story.tr: HOBr fazı sabitlenince X Sinyali ilk kez iki ayrı yankıya bölündü. Dr. Edward Atom bunun bir koordinat değil, bir talimat olduğunu fark etti: iki küçük yapı önce kendi içinde tamamlanmalı, sonra tek bir molekül hâline gelmeliydi. Rezonans Kasası ilk Moleküler Birleşim deneyini açtı.
story.en: Once the HOBr phase stabilized, the X Signal split into two distinct echoes for the first time. Dr. Edward Atom realized it was not a coordinate, but an instruction: two smaller structures had to be completed first, then joined into a single molecule. The Resonance Vault opened its first Molecular Fusion experiment.
story.de: Als sich die HOBr-Phase stabilisierte, teilte sich das X-Signal erstmals in zwei getrennte Echos. Dr. Edward Atom erkannte, dass es keine Koordinate, sondern eine Anweisung war: Zuerst mussten zwei kleinere Strukturen entstehen, dann zu einem einzigen Molekül verschmelzen. Der Resonanz-Tresor öffnete sein erstes Experiment zur molekularen Fusion.
story.es: Cuando la fase de HOBr se estabilizó, la Señal X se dividió por primera vez en dos ecos distintos. Dr. Edward Atom comprendió que no era una coordenada, sino una instrucción: primero había que completar dos estructuras pequeñas y después unirlas en una sola molécula. La Bóveda de Resonancia abrió su primer experimento de Fusión Molecular.
story.pt: Quando a fase de HOBr se estabilizou, o Sinal X se dividiu pela primeira vez em dois ecos distintos. Dr. Edward Atom percebeu que não era uma coordenada, mas uma instrução: duas estruturas menores precisavam ser concluídas primeiro e depois unidas em uma única molécula. A Câmara de Ressonância abriu seu primeiro experimento de Fusão Molecular.
story.ja: HOBrの位相が安定すると、Xシグナルは初めて二つの異なる反響に分かれた。Dr. Edward Atomは、それが座標ではなく指示だと気づく。まず二つの小さな構造を完成させ、その後ひとつの分子へ結合しなければならない。共鳴保管庫は最初の分子フュージョン実験を開いた。
story.fr: Lorsque la phase HOBr se stabilisa, le Signal X se divisa pour la première fois en deux échos distincts. Dr. Edward Atom comprit qu’il ne s’agissait pas d’une coordonnée, mais d’une instruction : deux petites structures devaient d’abord être complétées, puis réunies en une seule molécule. La Chambre de Résonance ouvrit son premier essai de Fusion moléculaire.
story.zh: HOBr相位稳定后，X信号第一次分裂成两道清晰的回声。Dr. Edward Atom意识到这并不是一个坐标，而是一条指令：必须先完成两个较小的结构，再把它们合并成一个完整分子。共振库由此开启了第一次分子融合实验。
story.it: Quando la fase HOBr si stabilizzò, il Segnale X si divise per la prima volta in due echi distinti. Dr. Edward Atom capì che non era una coordinata, ma un’istruzione: due strutture più piccole dovevano essere completate prima e poi unite in un’unica molecola. La Camera di Risonanza aprì il suo primo esperimento di Fusione Molecolare.
story.ko: Once the HOBr phase stabilized, the X Signal split into two distinct echoes for the first time. Dr. Edward Atom realized it was not a coordinate, but an instruction: two smaller structures had to be completed first, then joined into a single molecule. The Resonance Vault opened its first Molecular Fusion experiment.
story.ru: Once the HOBr phase stabilized, the X Signal split into two distinct echoes for the first time. Dr. Edward Atom realized it was not a coordinate, but an instruction: two smaller structures had to be completed first, then joined into a single molecule. The Resonance Vault opened its first Molecular Fusion experiment.

campaign.lesson: Molecular Fusion: build compatible sulfur/chlorine and sulfur/oxygen fragments, then assemble the complete Cl₂S₂O target by any legal route.

story.tr: İlk Moleküler Birleşim kararlı kalınca Rezonans Kasası iki yeni parçayı kükürt hattına yönlendirdi. Cl₂S₂O hedefi, farklı koridorlardan aynı yapıya ulaşılabildiğini gösteriyordu; kasa ezberlenmiş rotayı değil, doğru birleşimi ölçüyordu.
story.en: Once the first Molecular Fusion stayed stable, the Resonance Vault routed new fragments into the sulfur line. The Cl₂S₂O target showed that different corridors could reach the same structure; the vault was measuring a correct fusion, not a memorized route.
story.de: Nachdem die erste molekulare Fusion stabil blieb, leitete der Resonanz-Tresor neue Fragmente in die Schwefellinie. Das Ziel Cl₂S₂O zeigte, dass verschiedene Korridore zur gleichen Struktur führen können; gemessen wurde die korrekte Fusion, nicht eine auswendig gelernte Route.
story.es: Cuando la primera Fusión Molecular se mantuvo estable, la Bóveda de Resonancia dirigió nuevos fragmentos hacia la línea de azufre. El objetivo Cl₂S₂O demostró que distintos corredores podían llegar a la misma estructura; la bóveda medía una fusión correcta, no una ruta memorizada.
story.pt: Quando a primeira Fusão Molecular permaneceu estável, a Câmara de Ressonância enviou novos fragmentos para a linha de enxofre. O alvo Cl₂S₂O mostrou que corredores diferentes podiam chegar à mesma estrutura; a câmara media a fusão correta, não uma rota decorada.
story.ja: 最初の分子フュージョンが安定すると、共鳴保管庫は新しい断片を硫黄ラインへ送った。Cl₂S₂Oの目標は、異なる経路から同じ構造へ到達できることを示していた。測られているのは暗記したルートではなく、正しい融合そのものだ。
story.fr: Lorsque la première Fusion moléculaire resta stable, la Chambre de Résonance dirigea de nouveaux fragments vers la ligne du soufre. La cible Cl₂S₂O montrait que plusieurs couloirs pouvaient mener à la même structure ; la chambre mesurait une fusion correcte, pas un trajet mémorisé.
story.zh: 第一次分子融合稳定后，共振库把新的片段送入硫线路。Cl₂S₂O目标表明，不同通道也能到达同一结构；共振库衡量的是正确的融合，而不是背下来的路线。
story.it: Quando la prima Fusione Molecolare rimase stabile, la Camera di Risonanza inviò nuovi frammenti nella linea dello zolfo. Il bersaglio Cl₂S₂O mostrava che corridoi diversi potevano portare alla stessa struttura: la camera misurava una fusione corretta, non un percorso memorizzato.
story.ko: Once the first Molecular Fusion stayed stable, the Resonance Vault routed new fragments into the sulfur line. The Cl₂S₂O target showed that different corridors could reach the same structure; the vault was measuring a correct fusion, not a memorized route.
story.ru: Once the first Molecular Fusion stayed stable, the Resonance Vault routed new fragments into the sulfur line. The Cl₂S₂O target showed that different corridors could reach the same structure; the vault was measuring a correct fusion, not a memorized route.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 7: close a P4 square from two rigid P2 fragments without a fixed finish tile.

story.tr: Bir sonraki X darbesi düz bir çizgi yerine kendi üzerine kıvrıldı. Dört fosfor düğümü kapalı bir rezonans hücresi oluşturmalıydı; iki rijit parça doğru anda birleşirse P₄ karesi herhangi bir uygun noktada kapanabilirdi.
story.en: The next X pulse folded back on itself instead of forming a straight line. Four phosphorus nodes had to close a resonance cell; if the two rigid parts met at the right moment, the P₄ square could close at any suitable place on the board.
story.de: Der nächste X-Impuls faltete sich auf sich selbst zurück, statt eine gerade Linie zu bilden. Vier Phosphorknoten mussten eine geschlossene Resonanzzelle bilden; trafen die beiden starren Teile im richtigen Moment zusammen, konnte sich das P₄-Quadrat an jeder geeigneten Stelle schließen.
story.es: El siguiente pulso X se plegó sobre sí mismo en lugar de formar una línea recta. Cuatro nodos de fósforo debían cerrar una celda de resonancia; si las dos piezas rígidas se encontraban en el momento correcto, el cuadrado P₄ podía cerrarse en cualquier lugar adecuado.
story.pt: O próximo pulso X se dobrou sobre si mesmo em vez de formar uma linha reta. Quatro nós de fósforo precisavam fechar uma célula de ressonância; se as duas peças rígidas se encontrassem no momento certo, o quadrado P₄ poderia se fechar em qualquer ponto adequado.
story.ja: 次のXパルスは直線ではなく、自分自身へ折り返した。四つのリン原子が閉じた共鳴セルを作る必要がある。二つの剛体パーツが正しい瞬間に出会えば、P₄の正方形は盤面のどこでも完成できる。
story.fr: L’impulsion X suivante se replia sur elle-même au lieu de former une ligne droite. Quatre nœuds de phosphore devaient fermer une cellule de résonance ; si les deux pièces rigides se rejoignaient au bon moment, le carré P₄ pouvait se fermer n’importe où sur le plateau.
story.zh: 下一次X脉冲没有形成直线，而是向自身折回。四个磷节点必须闭合成一个共振单元；只要两个刚性片段在正确时机相遇，P₄方形就能在棋盘任意合适位置完成。
story.it: Il successivo impulso X si ripiegò su se stesso invece di formare una linea retta. Quattro nodi di fosforo dovevano chiudere una cella di risonanza; se i due frammenti rigidi si incontravano al momento giusto, il quadrato P₄ poteva chiudersi in qualsiasi punto adatto.
story.ko: The next X pulse folded back on itself instead of forming a straight line. Four phosphorus nodes had to close a resonance cell; if the two rigid parts met at the right moment, the P₄ square could close at any suitable place on the board.
story.ru: The next X pulse folded back on itself instead of forming a straight line. Four phosphorus nodes had to close a resonance cell; if the two rigid parts met at the right moment, the P₄ square could close at any suitable place on the board.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 8: preserve one pre-stabilized Si/H fragment while assembling and aligning the second module.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Moxy ikinci bir yankı yakalıyor ve yaklaşma sırasını tamamen değiştiriyor. H4Si2O bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Moxy detects a second echo, forcing a different order of approach. H4Si2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Moxy erkennt ein zweites Echo und erzwingt damit eine andere Reihenfolge der Annäherung. H4Si2O wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. Moxy detecta un segundo eco, obligando a cambiar el orden de aproximación. H4Si2O se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. Moxy detecta um segundo eco, obrigando a mudar a ordem de aproximação. H4Si2O se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 Moxyが第二の反響を検出し、接近の順番を変えざるを得なくなる。 H4Si2Oがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. Moxy détecte un second écho, imposant un nouvel ordre d’approche. H4Si2O devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 Moxy探测到第二道回声，迫使接近顺序发生改变。 H4Si2O成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. Moxy rileva una seconda eco, imponendo un diverso ordine di avvicinamento. H4Si2O diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Moxy detects a second echo, forcing a different order of approach. H4Si2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Moxy detects a second echo, forcing a different order of approach. H4Si2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 9: transport two completed rigid modules through a new corridor layout and fuse CH3SH.

story.tr: İki modül aynı anda kararlı hâle geldi. Artık sorun onları oluşturmak değil, dar koridorlarda biçimlerini bozmadan taşımaktı. CH₃SH imzası, Moleküler Birleşimin yalnızca atom yerleştirme değil, tamamlanmış yapıların lojistiği olduğunu gösterdi.
story.en: Two modules stabilized at the same time. The challenge was no longer forming them, but transporting them through tight corridors without changing their shape. The CH₃SH signature showed that Molecular Fusion was also about moving completed structures, not only placing atoms.
story.de: Zwei Module stabilisierten sich gleichzeitig. Die Herausforderung bestand nun nicht mehr darin, sie zu bilden, sondern sie unverändert durch enge Korridore zu transportieren. Die CH₃SH-Signatur zeigte, dass molekulare Fusion auch den Transport fertiger Strukturen bedeutet.
story.es: Dos módulos se estabilizaron al mismo tiempo. El reto ya no era formarlos, sino transportarlos por corredores estrechos sin alterar su forma. La firma CH₃SH demostró que la Fusión Molecular también consiste en mover estructuras completas, no solo en colocar átomos.
story.pt: Dois módulos se estabilizaram ao mesmo tempo. O desafio deixou de ser formá-los e passou a ser transportá-los por corredores estreitos sem alterar sua forma. A assinatura CH₃SH mostrou que a Fusão Molecular também envolve mover estruturas completas, não apenas posicionar átomos.
story.ja: 二つのモジュールが同時に安定した。課題は作ることではなく、形を崩さず狭い通路を運ぶことへ変わった。CH₃SHのシグネチャは、分子フュージョンが原子配置だけでなく完成構造の輸送でもあることを示した。
story.fr: Deux modules se stabilisèrent en même temps. Le défi n’était plus de les former, mais de les transporter dans des couloirs étroits sans modifier leur forme. La signature CH₃SH montra que la Fusion moléculaire concernait aussi le déplacement de structures complètes.
story.zh: 两个模块同时稳定下来。挑战不再是把它们组装出来，而是让它们在狭窄通道中保持形状并整体移动。CH₃SH特征说明，分子融合不仅是摆放原子，也是运输完整结构。
story.it: Due moduli si stabilizzarono nello stesso momento. La sfida non era più formarli, ma trasportarli attraverso corridoi stretti senza cambiarne la forma. La firma CH₃SH mostrò che la Fusione Molecolare riguarda anche il movimento di strutture complete, non solo il posizionamento degli atomi.
story.ko: Two modules stabilized at the same time. The challenge was no longer forming them, but transporting them through tight corridors without changing their shape. The CH₃SH signature showed that Molecular Fusion was also about moving completed structures, not only placing atoms.
story.ru: Two modules stabilized at the same time. The challenge was no longer forming them, but transporting them through tight corridors without changing their shape. The CH₃SH signature showed that Molecular Fusion was also about moving completed structures, not only placing atoms.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 10: close an S8 ring from two pre-stabilized four-atom arcs.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası ilk kez kapalı bir halka yansıttı. İki dört atomlu kükürt yayı birbirinden ayrı tutulmuştu; yalnız doğru yaklaşım S₈ halkasını kapatacaktı. Moxy, halka tamamlanmadan hemen önce sinyalin güçlendiğini hissetti.
story.en: For the first time, the Resonance Vault projected a closed ring. Two four-atom sulfur arcs were held apart; only the right approach would close the S₈ ring. Moxy felt the signal strengthen just before the loop was completed.
story.de: Zum ersten Mal projizierte der Resonanz-Tresor einen geschlossenen Ring. Zwei Schwefelbögen aus je vier Atomen wurden getrennt gehalten; nur die richtige Annäherung würde den S₈-Ring schließen. Moxy spürte, wie das Signal kurz vor dem Ringschluss stärker wurde.
story.es: Por primera vez, la Bóveda de Resonancia proyectó un anillo cerrado. Dos arcos de azufre de cuatro átomos estaban separados; solo el enfoque correcto cerraría el anillo S₈. Moxy sintió que la señal se intensificaba justo antes de completar el ciclo.
story.pt: Pela primeira vez, a Câmara de Ressonância projetou um anel fechado. Dois arcos de enxofre com quatro átomos cada estavam separados; apenas a aproximação correta fecharia o anel S₈. Moxy sentiu o sinal ficar mais forte pouco antes do fechamento.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫は初めて閉じたリングを投影した。四原子ずつの二つの硫黄アークが離されており、正しい接近だけがS₈リングを閉じる。ループ完成の直前、Moxyはシグナルが強まるのを感じた。
story.fr: Pour la première fois, la Chambre de Résonance projeta un anneau fermé. Deux arcs de soufre de quatre atomes étaient maintenus séparés ; seule la bonne approche fermerait l’anneau S₈. Moxy sentit le signal se renforcer juste avant la fermeture.
story.zh: 共振库第一次投射出一个闭合环。两个由四个硫原子组成的弧段彼此分离；只有正确的接近方式才能闭合S₈环。就在环完成前，Moxy感到信号明显增强。
story.it: Per la prima volta, la Camera di Risonanza proiettò un anello chiuso. Due archi di zolfo da quattro atomi erano tenuti separati; solo l’avvicinamento corretto avrebbe chiuso l’anello S₈. Moxy sentì il segnale intensificarsi appena prima della chiusura.
story.ko: For the first time, the Resonance Vault projected a closed ring. Two four-atom sulfur arcs were held apart; only the right approach would close the S₈ ring. Moxy felt the signal strengthen just before the loop was completed.
story.ru: For the first time, the Resonance Vault projected a closed ring. Two four-atom sulfur arcs were held apart; only the right approach would close the S₈ ring. Moxy felt the signal strengthen just before the loop was completed.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 11: assemble two N-H fragments in a new zig-zag layout and preserve final fusion space.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Sahte bir yankı sönüyor ve daha temiz ama daha affetmeyen bir yol ortaya çıkıyor. H2N2O bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. A false echo fades, revealing a cleaner but less forgiving path. H2N2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Ein falsches Echo verblasst und legt einen klareren, aber weniger verzeihenden Weg frei. H2N2O wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. Un eco falso se desvanece y revela una ruta más limpia, pero menos permisiva. H2N2O se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. Uma falsa eco desaparece e revela um caminho mais limpo, porém menos tolerante. H2N2O se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 偽の反響が消え、より明快だがミスを許さない経路が現れる。 H2N2Oがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. Un faux écho s’efface, révélant un chemin plus net mais moins indulgent. H2N2O devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 一道虚假回声消退，露出更清晰却更不容出错的路径。 H2N2O成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. Una falsa eco svanisce, rivelando un percorso più pulito ma meno indulgente. H2N2O diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. A false echo fades, revealing a cleaner but less forgiving path. H2N2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. A false echo fades, revealing a cleaner but less forgiving path. H2N2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 12: combine Molecular Fusion with three one-way phase markers; arrows constrain travel but do not prescribe the solution.

story.tr: Üç yön işareti aynı anda yandı. Dr. Null bunların bir çözüm tarifi olmadığını hemen fark etti: yalnızca geçişlerin hangi yönde kararlı kaldığını söylüyorlardı. As₄ karesini kurmanın yolu hâlâ oyuncuya aitti.
story.en: Three direction markers lit at the same time. Dr. Null immediately saw that they were not a solution recipe; they only showed which direction kept each passage stable. The route used to build the As₄ square was still up to the player.
story.de: Drei Richtungsmarkierungen leuchteten gleichzeitig auf. Dr. Null erkannte sofort, dass sie kein Lösungsrezept waren; sie zeigten nur, in welcher Richtung die Durchgänge stabil blieben. Wie das As₄-Quadrat gebaut wurde, blieb dem Spieler überlassen.
story.es: Tres marcadores de dirección se encendieron al mismo tiempo. Dr. Null comprendió de inmediato que no eran una receta de solución; solo indicaban en qué dirección se mantenía estable cada paso. La forma de construir el cuadrado As₄ seguía dependiendo del jugador.
story.pt: Três marcadores de direção acenderam ao mesmo tempo. Dr. Null percebeu imediatamente que não eram uma receita de solução; apenas mostravam em qual direção cada passagem permanecia estável. O caminho para montar o quadrado As₄ continuava nas mãos do jogador.
story.ja: 三つの方向マーカーが同時に点灯した。Dr. Nullはすぐに、それが解答手順ではないと見抜いた。示しているのは通路が安定する方向だけだ。As₄の正方形をどう作るかは、まだプレイヤー次第だった。
story.fr: Trois marqueurs de direction s’allumèrent en même temps. Dr. Null comprit aussitôt qu’ils ne donnaient pas la solution ; ils indiquaient seulement le sens dans lequel chaque passage restait stable. La manière de construire le carré As₄ restait libre.
story.zh: 三个方向标记同时亮起。Dr. Null立刻看出它们并不是解题步骤，只是在说明各通道保持稳定的方向。如何构建As₄方形，仍由玩家自己决定。
story.it: Tre indicatori di direzione si accesero nello stesso momento. Dr. Null capì subito che non erano una ricetta per la soluzione: indicavano soltanto la direzione in cui ogni passaggio restava stabile. Il modo di costruire il quadrato As₄ rimaneva libero.
story.ko: Three direction markers lit at the same time. Dr. Null immediately saw that they were not a solution recipe; they only showed which direction kept each passage stable. The route used to build the As₄ square was still up to the player.
story.ru: Three direction markers lit at the same time. Dr. Null immediately saw that they were not a solution recipe; they only showed which direction kept each passage stable. The route used to build the As₄ square was still up to the player.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 13: align two pre-stabilized three-atom N/F modules into N2F4.

story.tr: Kasadan bu kez iki önceden kararlı N/F modülü çıktı. Aralarındaki mesafe küçüktü ama koridorlar daralmıştı; N₂F₄ ancak iki yapının kendi biçimini koruyarak doğru hizaya taşınmasıyla tamamlanacaktı.
story.en: This time the vault released two pre-stabilized N/F modules. The distance between them was small, but the corridors had narrowed; N₂F₄ would complete only if both structures were transported into alignment without losing their shape.
story.de: Diesmal gab der Tresor zwei bereits stabilisierte N/F-Module frei. Der Abstand zwischen ihnen war klein, doch die Korridore waren enger geworden; N₂F₄ konnte nur entstehen, wenn beide Strukturen formstabil in die richtige Ausrichtung gebracht wurden.
story.es: Esta vez la bóveda liberó dos módulos N/F ya estabilizados. La distancia era corta, pero los corredores se habían estrechado; N₂F₄ solo se completaría si ambas estructuras llegaban alineadas sin perder su forma.
story.pt: Desta vez a câmara liberou dois módulos N/F já estabilizados. A distância entre eles era pequena, mas os corredores haviam se estreitado; N₂F₄ só seria concluído se as duas estruturas fossem levadas ao alinhamento sem perder a forma.
story.ja: 今度は事前に安定化された二つのN/Fモジュールが放出された。距離は短いが通路は狭い。二つの構造を形を崩さず正しく整列させたときだけN₂F₄が完成する。
story.fr: Cette fois, la chambre libéra deux modules N/F déjà stabilisés. La distance était courte, mais les couloirs s’étaient resserrés ; N₂F₄ ne serait complété que si les deux structures étaient amenées en alignement sans perdre leur forme.
story.zh: 这一次，共振库释放了两个预先稳定的N/F模块。它们之间距离不远，但通道变得更狭窄；只有在保持形状的同时把两个结构送到正确对齐位置，N₂F₄才能完成。
story.it: Questa volta la camera liberò due moduli N/F già stabilizzati. La distanza era breve, ma i corridoi si erano ristretti; N₂F₄ si sarebbe completato solo portando entrambe le strutture in allineamento senza perderne la forma.
story.ko: This time the vault released two pre-stabilized N/F modules. The distance between them was small, but the corridors had narrowed; N₂F₄ would complete only if both structures were transported into alignment without losing their shape.
story.ru: This time the vault released two pre-stabilized N/F modules. The distance between them was small, but the corridors had narrowed; N₂F₄ would complete only if both structures were transported into alignment without losing their shape.

campaign.lesson: Resonance Vault 14: close a Se8 ring from two rigid Se4 arcs in a completely different corridor geometry.

story.tr: Son testte kükürt halkasının deseni selenyumla geri döndü, fakat kasanın iç koridorları tamamen değişmişti. İki Se₄ yayı birleşip Se₈ halkasını kapattığında iç mühür açıldı. Arkasında, X Sinyalinin daha derin bir katmana indiğini gösteren yeni bir iz vardı.
story.en: In the last test, the sulfur-ring pattern returned in selenium, but the vault’s inner corridors had changed completely. When the two Se₄ arcs joined and closed the Se₈ ring, the inner seal opened. Behind it was a new trace showing the X Signal descending into a deeper layer.
story.de: Im letzten Test kehrte das Muster des Schwefelrings mit Selen zurück, doch die inneren Korridore des Tresors waren völlig verändert. Als sich die beiden Se₄-Bögen zum Se₈-Ring schlossen, öffnete sich das innere Siegel. Dahinter führte eine neue Spur des X-Signals in eine tiefere Ebene.
story.es: En la última prueba, el patrón del anillo de azufre regresó con selenio, pero los corredores internos de la bóveda habían cambiado por completo. Cuando los dos arcos Se₄ se unieron y cerraron el anillo Se₈, se abrió el sello interior. Detrás apareció una nueva traza del X Signal hacia una capa más profunda.
story.pt: No último teste, o padrão do anel de enxofre voltou em forma de selênio, mas os corredores internos da câmara haviam mudado por completo. Quando os dois arcos Se₄ se uniram e fecharam o anel Se₈, o selo interno se abriu. Atrás dele havia um novo rastro do Sinal X descendo para uma camada mais profunda.
story.ja: 最後の試験では、硫黄リングのパターンがセレンで再現された。しかし保管庫内部の通路は完全に変化していた。二つのSe₄アークが結合してSe₈リングを閉じると、内側の封印が開いた。その奥にはXシグナルがさらに深い層へ下っていることを示す新たな痕跡があった。
story.fr: Dans le dernier test, le motif de l’anneau de soufre revint sous forme de sélénium, mais les couloirs intérieurs de la chambre avaient complètement changé. Lorsque les deux arcs Se₄ se réunirent pour fermer l’anneau Se₈, le sceau intérieur s’ouvrit. Derrière lui, une nouvelle trace montrait le Signal X descendant vers une couche plus profonde.
story.zh: 最后一次测试中，硫环的模式以硒重新出现，但共振库内部通道已经完全改变。两个Se₄弧段合并并闭合Se₈环后，内层封印开启。封印后方出现了一条新轨迹，显示X信号正在进入更深层。
story.it: Nell’ultimo test, il modello dell’anello di zolfo tornò sotto forma di selenio, ma i corridoi interni della camera erano cambiati completamente. Quando i due archi Se₄ si unirono chiudendo l’anello Se₈, il sigillo interno si aprì. Dietro di esso comparve una nuova traccia del Segnale X diretta verso uno strato più profondo.
story.ko: In the last test, the sulfur-ring pattern returned in selenium, but the vault’s inner corridors had changed completely. When the two Se₄ arcs joined and closed the Se₈ ring, the inner seal opened. Behind it was a new trace showing the X Signal descending into a deeper layer.
story.ru: In the last test, the sulfur-ring pattern returned in selenium, but the vault’s inner corridors had changed completely. When the two Se₄ arcs joined and closed the Se₈ ring, the inner seal opened. Behind it was a new trace showing the X Signal descending into a deeper layer.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Portal: assemble the two S/F sub-structures, then use portal routing before or between fusion locks. The final S₂F₂ may be completed anywhere that matches the target geometry.

story.en: The inner seal opened onto a phase corridor where the X Signal appeared in two places at once. Dr. Edward Atom used S₂F₂ to test whether a newly fused structure could still be routed through the old portal network without losing its molecular plan.
story.tr: İç mühür, X Sinyalinin aynı anda iki noktada göründüğü bir faz koridoruna açıldı. Dr. Edward Atom, yeni birleşmiş bir yapının moleküler düzenini bozmadan eski portal ağı içinde yönlendirilip yönlendirilemeyeceğini S₂F₂ ile sınadı.
story.de: Das innere Siegel öffnete sich zu einem Phasenkorridor, in dem das X-Signal gleichzeitig an zwei Orten erschien. Dr. Edward Atom prüfte mit S₂F₂, ob sich eine neu fusionierte Struktur durch das alte Portalnetz führen ließ, ohne ihren molekularen Plan zu verlieren.
story.es: El sello interior se abrió a un corredor de fase donde la Señal X aparecía en dos lugares a la vez. Dr. Edward Atom usó S₂F₂ para comprobar si una estructura recién fusionada podía atravesar la antigua red de portales sin perder su diseño molecular.
story.pt: O selo interno se abriu para um corredor de fase onde o Sinal X aparecia em dois lugares ao mesmo tempo. Dr. Edward Atom usou S₂F₂ para testar se uma estrutura recém-fundida podia atravessar a antiga rede de portais sem perder seu arranjo molecular.
story.ja: 内側の封印の先には、Xシグナルが同時に二か所へ現れる位相回廊があった。Dr. Edward AtomはS₂F₂を使い、融合したばかりの構造が分子配置を崩さず旧ポータル網を通れるか試した。
story.fr: Le sceau intérieur s’ouvrit sur un couloir de phase où le Signal X apparaissait à deux endroits à la fois. Dr. Edward Atom utilisa S₂F₂ pour vérifier qu’une structure nouvellement fusionnée pouvait traverser l’ancien réseau de portails sans perdre son organisation moléculaire.
story.zh: 内层封印通向一条相位走廊，X信号竟同时出现在两个位置。Dr. Edward Atom用S₂F₂测试新融合的结构能否在不破坏分子排列的情况下穿过旧有传送门网络。
story.it: Il sigillo interno si aprì su un corridoio di fase in cui il Segnale X appariva in due punti contemporaneamente. Dr. Edward Atom usò S₂F₂ per verificare se una struttura appena fusa potesse attraversare la vecchia rete di portali senza perdere il proprio assetto molecolare.
story.ko: The inner seal opened onto a phase corridor where the X Signal appeared in two places at once. Dr. Edward Atom used S₂F₂ to test whether a newly fused structure could still be routed through the old portal network without losing its molecular plan.
story.ru: The inner seal opened onto a phase corridor where the X Signal appeared in two places at once. Dr. Edward Atom used S₂F₂ to test whether a newly fused structure could still be routed through the old portal network without losing its molecular plan.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Direction Field: build the H–C–H module and respect the two one-way phase arrows while bringing sulfur into the final geometry.

story.en: Beyond the portal corridor, the signal became directional. Two phase arrows stabilized only one flow at a time, so the CH₂OS fragment had to be assembled with enough room left for the final atom.
story.tr: Portal koridorunun ötesinde sinyal yön kazandı. İki faz oku aynı anda yalnız belirli akışları kararlı tutuyordu; bu yüzden CH₂OS parçası, son atom için yeterli alan bırakılarak kurulmalıydı.
story.de: Hinter dem Portalkorridor wurde das Signal richtungsabhängig. Zwei Phasenpfeile stabilisierten jeweils nur eine Flussrichtung, daher musste das CH₂OS-Fragment mit genügend Platz für das letzte Atom aufgebaut werden.
story.es: Más allá del corredor de portales, la señal adquirió dirección. Dos flechas de fase solo estabilizaban ciertos flujos, así que el fragmento CH₂OS debía montarse dejando espacio para el átomo final.
story.pt: Além do corredor de portais, o sinal ganhou direção. Duas setas de fase estabilizavam apenas certos fluxos, então o fragmento CH₂OS precisava ser montado deixando espaço para o átomo final.
story.ja: ポータル回廊の先で、シグナルは方向性を持ち始めた。二つの位相矢印は特定方向の流れだけを安定させるため、CH₂OS断片は最後の原子のための空間を残して組み立てる必要があった。
story.fr: Au-delà du couloir de portails, le signal devint directionnel. Deux flèches de phase ne stabilisaient que certains flux ; le fragment CH₂OS devait donc être assemblé en gardant de la place pour le dernier atome.
story.zh: 穿过传送门走廊后，信号开始具有方向性。两个相位箭头只能稳定特定方向的流动，因此构建CH₂OS片段时必须为最后一个原子留下空间。
story.it: Oltre il corridoio dei portali, il segnale divenne direzionale. Due frecce di fase stabilizzavano solo determinati flussi, quindi il frammento CH₂OS doveva essere assemblato lasciando spazio per l’atomo finale.
story.ko: Beyond the portal corridor, the signal became directional. Two phase arrows stabilized only one flow at a time, so the CH₂OS fragment had to be assembled with enough room left for the final atom.
story.ru: Beyond the portal corridor, the signal became directional. Two phase arrows stabilized only one flow at a time, so the CH₂OS fragment had to be assembled with enough room left for the final atom.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Portal + Direction Field: portal travel and one-way tiles both shape the route; the final NCl₃ position is not fixed.

story.en: A portal echo crossed a pair of directional gates and produced a second resonance layer. The NCl₃ trial showed that old mechanisms were no longer separate obstacles: the vault was beginning to combine them deliberately around Fusion.
story.tr: Bir portal yankısı iki yön kapısından geçerek ikinci bir rezonans katmanı oluşturdu. NCl₃ deneyi, eski mekaniklerin artık ayrı engeller olmadığını gösterdi: kasa onları Fusion çevresinde bilinçli biçimde birleştirmeye başlıyordu.
story.de: Ein Portal-Echo durchquerte zwei Richtungstore und erzeugte eine zweite Resonanzschicht. Der NCl₃-Test zeigte, dass die alten Mechaniken keine getrennten Hindernisse mehr waren: Der Tresor kombinierte sie nun bewusst mit Fusion.
story.es: Un eco de portal cruzó dos compuertas direccionales y creó una segunda capa de resonancia. La prueba NCl₃ mostró que las mecánicas antiguas ya no eran obstáculos separados: la bóveda empezaba a combinarlas deliberadamente con Fusion.
story.pt: Um eco de portal atravessou dois portões direcionais e criou uma segunda camada de ressonância. O teste NCl₃ mostrou que as mecânicas antigas já não eram obstáculos separados: a câmara começava a combiná-las de propósito com Fusion.
story.ja: ポータルの残響が二つの方向ゲートを通過し、第二の共鳴層を生んだ。NCl₃試験は、旧メカニクスがもはや別々の障害ではなく、保管庫がFusionの周囲で意図的に組み合わせ始めたことを示した。
story.fr: Un écho de portail traversa deux portes directionnelles et créa une seconde couche de résonance. L’essai NCl₃ montra que les anciennes mécaniques n’étaient plus des obstacles séparés : la chambre commençait à les combiner volontairement autour de la Fusion.
story.zh: 一道传送门回声穿过两个方向闸门，形成了第二层共振。NCl₃试验表明，旧机制已不再是彼此独立的障碍；共振库开始有意围绕Fusion将它们组合起来。
story.it: Un’eco del portale attraversò due varchi direzionali e creò un secondo strato di risonanza. La prova NCl₃ mostrò che le vecchie meccaniche non erano più ostacoli separati: la camera iniziava a combinarle deliberatamente attorno alla Fusion.
story.ko: A portal echo crossed a pair of directional gates and produced a second resonance layer. The NCl₃ trial showed that old mechanisms were no longer separate obstacles: the vault was beginning to combine them deliberately around Fusion.
story.ru: A portal echo crossed a pair of directional gates and produced a second resonance layer. The NCl₃ trial showed that old mechanisms were no longer separate obstacles: the vault was beginning to combine them deliberately around Fusion.

campaign.lesson: Three-Arrow Fusion: move the pre-stabilized Sn/F module as a rigid group; three arrows restrict travel but never prescribe a single finish location.

story.en: Three phase arrows formed a stable vector field around a pre-stabilized SnF₄ core. Dr. Null noted that the arrows still did not tell them where to finish; they only changed which routes remained physically possible.
story.tr: Üç faz oku, önceden kararlı SnF₄ çekirdeğinin çevresinde bir vektör alanı oluşturdu. Dr. Null okların yine bitiş yerini söylemediğini fark etti; yalnızca hangi rotaların fiziksel olarak mümkün kaldığını değiştiriyorlardı.
story.de: Drei Phasenpfeile bildeten ein stabiles Vektorfeld um einen vorstabilisierten SnF₄-Kern. Dr. Null bemerkte, dass die Pfeile weiterhin keinen Zielort vorgaben; sie veränderten nur, welche Wege physikalisch möglich blieben.
story.es: Tres flechas de fase formaron un campo vectorial estable alrededor de un núcleo SnF₄ preestabilizado. Dr. Null observó que las flechas seguían sin indicar dónde terminar; solo cambiaban qué rutas seguían siendo físicamente posibles.
story.pt: Três setas de fase formaram um campo vetorial estável ao redor de um núcleo SnF₄ pré-estabilizado. Dr. Null observou que elas ainda não indicavam onde terminar; apenas mudavam quais rotas continuavam fisicamente possíveis.
story.ja: 三つの位相矢印が、事前安定化されたSnF₄コアの周囲にベクトル場を形成した。Dr. Nullは、矢印が完成位置を指示するのではなく、物理的に可能な経路だけを変えていると確認した。
story.fr: Trois flèches de phase formèrent un champ vectoriel stable autour d’un noyau SnF₄ pré-stabilisé. Dr. Null remarqua qu’elles n’indiquaient toujours pas où terminer ; elles modifiaient seulement les routes physiquement possibles.
story.zh: 三个相位箭头在预先稳定的SnF₄核心周围形成了稳定的矢量场。Dr. Null指出，箭头依旧不会告诉他们终点在哪里；它们只会改变哪些路线在物理上仍然可行。
story.it: Tre frecce di fase formarono un campo vettoriale stabile attorno a un nucleo SnF₄ già stabilizzato. Dr. Null notò che le frecce non indicavano ancora dove terminare: cambiavano soltanto quali percorsi restavano fisicamente possibili.
story.ko: Three phase arrows formed a stable vector field around a pre-stabilized SnF₄ core. Dr. Null noted that the arrows still did not tell them where to finish; they only changed which routes remained physically possible.
story.ru: Three phase arrows formed a stable vector field around a pre-stabilized SnF₄ core. Dr. Null noted that the arrows still did not tell them where to finish; they only changed which routes remained physically possible.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Portal: assemble the O–C–O backbone, then route sulfur through the distant portal pair to complete the CO₂S target.

story.en: The X Signal collapsed into a thin atmospheric trace and vanished between two distant portal nodes. The CO₂S target reproduced the same disappearance-and-return pattern; the vault was measuring transport as carefully as structure.
story.tr: X Sinyali ince bir atmosferik ize dönüştü ve iki uzak portal düğümü arasında kayboldu. CO₂S hedefi aynı kaybolup geri gelme desenini tekrarladı; kasa yapıyı ölçtüğü kadar taşınmayı da ölçüyordu.
story.de: Das X-Signal schrumpfte zu einer dünnen atmosphärischen Spur und verschwand zwischen zwei entfernten Portalknoten. Das CO₂S-Ziel wiederholte dieses Muster aus Verschwinden und Rückkehr; der Tresor maß den Transport ebenso genau wie die Struktur.
story.es: La Señal X se redujo a una fina traza atmosférica y desapareció entre dos nodos de portal distantes. El objetivo CO₂S reprodujo el mismo patrón de desaparición y regreso; la bóveda medía el transporte con tanta precisión como la estructura.
story.pt: O Sinal X se reduziu a um fino rastro atmosférico e desapareceu entre dois nós de portal distantes. O alvo CO₂S repetiu o mesmo padrão de sumir e retornar; a câmara media o transporte com tanto cuidado quanto a estrutura.
story.ja: Xシグナルは細い大気の痕跡へ縮み、離れた二つのポータルノードの間で消えた。CO₂Sの目標も同じ消失と再出現を示し、保管庫が構造だけでなく輸送も精密に測っていることを示した。
story.fr: Le Signal X se réduisit à une fine trace atmosphérique et disparut entre deux nœuds de portail éloignés. La cible CO₂S reproduisit le même schéma de disparition et de retour ; la chambre mesurait le transport aussi précisément que la structure.
story.zh: X信号收缩成一条细微的大气痕迹，并在两个相距很远的传送门节点之间消失。CO₂S目标重复了同样的消失与回归模式；共振库对运输过程的测量与对结构同样精细。
story.it: Il Segnale X si ridusse a una sottile traccia atmosferica e scomparve tra due nodi di portale lontani. Il bersaglio CO₂S riprodusse lo stesso schema di scomparsa e ritorno; la camera misurava il trasporto con la stessa precisione della struttura.
story.ko: The X Signal collapsed into a thin atmospheric trace and vanished between two distant portal nodes. The CO₂S target reproduced the same disappearance-and-return pattern; the vault was measuring transport as carefully as structure.
story.ru: The X Signal collapsed into a thin atmospheric trace and vanished between two distant portal nodes. The CO₂S target reproduced the same disappearance-and-return pattern; the vault was measuring transport as carefully as structure.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Direction Field: lock H–O as a rigid pair, then route it through two directional tiles to meet fluorine.

story.en: A tiny oxygen–fluorine branch flickered at the edge of the chamber. HOF was too reactive to treat casually, so the team used the directional field only as a model, keeping the experiment virtual and tightly controlled.
story.tr: Kasanın kenarında küçük bir oksijen–flor dalı titreşti. HOF dikkatsizce ele alınamayacak kadar reaktifti; ekip deneyi tamamen sanal ve kontrollü tutarak yön alanını yalnız bir model olarak kullandı.
story.de: Am Rand der Kammer flackerte ein kleiner Sauerstoff-Fluor-Zweig. HOF war zu reaktiv für einen sorglosen Umgang; das Team nutzte das Richtungsfeld daher nur als Modell und hielt das Experiment vollständig virtuell und kontrolliert.
story.es: En el borde de la cámara parpadeó una pequeña rama de oxígeno y flúor. HOF era demasiado reactivo para tratarlo sin cuidado, así que el equipo usó el campo direccional solo como modelo y mantuvo el experimento virtual y controlado.
story.pt: Na borda da câmara surgiu um pequeno ramo de oxigênio e flúor. HOF era reativo demais para ser tratado sem cuidado, então a equipe usou o campo direcional apenas como modelo e manteve o experimento virtual e controlado.
story.ja: 室内の端で小さな酸素–フッ素の分岐が瞬いた。HOFは非常に反応性が高いため、チームは方向場をモデルとしてのみ使い、実験を完全に仮想かつ管理された状態に保った。
story.fr: Une petite branche oxygène–fluor vacilla au bord de la chambre. HOF étant beaucoup trop réactif pour être manipulé sans précaution, l’équipe utilisa le champ directionnel uniquement comme modèle et maintint l’expérience virtuelle et strictement contrôlée.
story.zh: 舱室边缘闪现出一条微小的氧–氟分支。HOF反应性极强，团队只把方向场作为模型使用，并让整个实验保持虚拟且严格受控。
story.it: Sul bordo della camera tremolò un piccolo ramo ossigeno-fluoro. HOF era troppo reattivo per essere trattato con leggerezza, così il team usò il campo direzionale solo come modello e mantenne l’esperimento virtuale e strettamente controllato.
story.ko: A tiny oxygen–fluorine branch flickered at the edge of the chamber. HOF was too reactive to treat casually, so the team used the directional field only as a model, keeping the experiment virtual and tightly controlled.
story.ru: A tiny oxygen–fluorine branch flickered at the edge of the chamber. HOF was too reactive to treat casually, so the team used the directional field only as a model, keeping the experiment virtual and tightly controlled.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Portal + Direction Field: form the O–C–Cl sub-structure, then combine portal travel and two one-way constraints to complete COCl₂.

story.en: The next resonance was heavier and more dangerous: COCl₂. The vault paired portal transport with directional constraints, while Dr. Edward Atom insisted that the laboratory display it only as a molecular model—not as a substance to handle.
story.tr: Sonraki rezonans daha ağır ve daha tehlikeliydi: COCl₂. Kasa portal taşınmasını yön kısıtlarıyla birleştirdi; Dr. Edward Atom ise bunun laboratuvarda yalnızca moleküler model olarak gösterilmesinde ısrar etti, elle tutulacak bir madde olarak değil.
story.de: Die nächste Resonanz war schwerer und gefährlicher: COCl₂. Der Tresor kombinierte Portaltransport mit Richtungsbeschränkungen, während Dr. Edward Atom darauf bestand, es im Labor nur als Molekülmodell zu zeigen – nicht als Stoff zum Anfassen.
story.es: La siguiente resonancia era más pesada y peligrosa: COCl₂. La bóveda combinó transporte por portal con restricciones direccionales, mientras Dr. Edward Atom insistía en mostrarlo solo como modelo molecular, no como sustancia para manipular.
story.pt: A ressonância seguinte era mais pesada e perigosa: COCl₂. A câmara combinou transporte por portal com restrições direcionais, enquanto Dr. Edward Atom insistiu que ele fosse mostrado apenas como modelo molecular, não como substância para manuseio.
story.ja: 次の共鳴はより重く危険なCOCl₂だった。保管庫はポータル輸送と方向制約を組み合わせたが、Dr. Edward Atomは実物を扱うのではなく分子モデルとしてのみ表示することを徹底した。
story.fr: La résonance suivante était plus lourde et plus dangereuse : COCl₂. La chambre associa transport par portail et contraintes directionnelles, tandis que Dr. Edward Atom exigea qu’il soit présenté uniquement comme modèle moléculaire, jamais comme substance à manipuler.
story.zh: 下一次共振更重也更危险：COCl₂。共振库把传送门运输与方向限制结合起来，而Dr. Edward Atom坚持实验室只能把它作为分子模型展示，而不是可供操作的真实物质。
story.it: La risonanza successiva era più pesante e pericolosa: COCl₂. La camera combinò il trasporto tramite portale con vincoli direzionali, mentre Dr. Edward Atom insistette perché fosse mostrato solo come modello molecolare, non come sostanza da maneggiare.
story.ko: The next resonance was heavier and more dangerous: COCl₂. The vault paired portal transport with directional constraints, while Dr. Edward Atom insisted that the laboratory display it only as a molecular model—not as a substance to handle.
story.ru: The next resonance was heavier and more dangerous: COCl₂. The vault paired portal transport with directional constraints, while Dr. Edward Atom insisted that the laboratory display it only as a molecular model—not as a substance to handle.

campaign.lesson: Three-Arrow Rigid Module: a pre-stabilized O–Xe–O module moves as one body while three phase arrows reshape available routes.

story.en: Three phase markers locked around a xenon–oxygen pattern. When the pre-stabilized XeO₄ segment moved as one body, the X Signal brightened sharply—as if noble-gas chemistry were another key to the vault’s deeper logic.
story.tr: Üç faz işareti ksenon–oksijen deseninin çevresinde kilitlendi. Önceden kararlı XeO₄ parçası tek gövde gibi hareket ettiğinde X Sinyali aniden güçlendi; sanki soy gaz kimyası kasanın daha derin mantığının başka bir anahtarıydı.
story.de: Drei Phasenmarkierungen rasteten um ein Xenon-Sauerstoff-Muster ein. Als sich das vorstabilisierte XeO₄-Segment wie ein Körper bewegte, leuchtete das X-Signal stark auf – als wäre die Edelgaschemie ein weiterer Schlüssel zur tieferen Logik des Tresors.
story.es: Tres marcadores de fase se fijaron alrededor de un patrón de xenón y oxígeno. Cuando el segmento XeO₄ preestabilizado se movió como un solo cuerpo, la Señal X aumentó de intensidad, como si la química de los gases nobles fuera otra clave de la lógica profunda de la bóveda.
story.pt: Três marcadores de fase se fixaram ao redor de um padrão de xenônio e oxigênio. Quando o segmento XeO₄ pré-estabilizado se moveu como um único corpo, o Sinal X brilhou com força, como se a química dos gases nobres fosse outra chave da lógica profunda da câmara.
story.ja: 三つの位相マーカーがキセノン–酸素パターンの周囲で固定された。事前安定化されたXeO₄セグメントが一体となって動くとXシグナルが強く輝き、希ガス化学も保管庫の深い論理を解く鍵であるかのようだった。
story.fr: Trois marqueurs de phase se verrouillèrent autour d’un motif xénon–oxygène. Lorsque le segment XeO₄ pré-stabilisé se déplaça comme un seul corps, le Signal X s’intensifia brusquement, comme si la chimie des gaz nobles était une autre clé de la logique profonde de la chambre.
story.zh: 三个相位标记锁定在氙–氧结构周围。预先稳定的XeO₄片段作为一个整体移动时，X信号突然增强，仿佛稀有气体化学也是解开共振库深层逻辑的一把钥匙。
story.it: Tre indicatori di fase si bloccarono attorno a uno schema xeno-ossigeno. Quando il segmento XeO₄ già stabilizzato si mosse come un unico corpo, il Segnale X aumentò nettamente, come se la chimica dei gas nobili fosse un’altra chiave della logica più profonda della camera.
story.ko: Three phase markers locked around a xenon–oxygen pattern. When the pre-stabilized XeO₄ segment moved as one body, the X Signal brightened sharply—as if noble-gas chemistry were another key to the vault’s deeper logic.
story.ru: Three phase markers locked around a xenon–oxygen pattern. When the pre-stabilized XeO₄ segment moved as one body, the X Signal brightened sharply—as if noble-gas chemistry were another key to the vault’s deeper logic.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Portal: form the H–C–H module, route through the portal network, and attach oxygen without a fixed finish coordinate.

story.en: A familiar organic signature appeared next: CH₂O. Its pattern was simple, but the portal geometry was not. Moxy’s sensors registered the first hint that the X Signal might be leading from pure molecular assembly toward biological chemistry.
story.tr: Sırada tanıdık bir organik imza belirdi: CH₂O. Deseni basitti ama portal geometrisi değildi. Moxy’nin sensörleri, X Sinyalinin saf molekül kurulumundan biyolojik kimyaya doğru ilerliyor olabileceğine dair ilk ipucunu yakaladı.
story.de: Als Nächstes erschien eine vertraute organische Signatur: CH₂O. Das Muster war einfach, die Portalgeometrie jedoch nicht. Moxys Sensoren registrierten den ersten Hinweis darauf, dass das X-Signal von reiner Molekülmontage in Richtung Biochemie führen könnte.
story.es: Después apareció una firma orgánica conocida: CH₂O. El patrón era sencillo, pero la geometría de portales no. Los sensores de Moxy detectaron la primera pista de que la Señal X quizá avanzaba desde el ensamblaje molecular puro hacia la química biológica.
story.pt: Em seguida surgiu uma assinatura orgânica familiar: CH₂O. O padrão era simples, mas a geometria dos portais não. Os sensores de Moxy registraram o primeiro indício de que o Sinal X talvez estivesse levando da montagem molecular pura para a química biológica.
story.ja: 次に現れたのは見覚えのある有機分子CH₂Oだった。構造は単純でもポータル配置は複雑だった。Moxyのセンサーは、Xシグナルが純粋な分子組立から生物化学へ向かっている可能性を初めて捉えた。
story.fr: Une signature organique familière apparut ensuite : CH₂O. Son motif était simple, mais pas la géométrie des portails. Les capteurs de Moxy relevèrent le premier indice que le Signal X pouvait conduire de l’assemblage moléculaire pur vers la chimie biologique.
story.zh: 接着出现的是熟悉的有机分子信号：CH₂O。它的结构并不复杂，但传送门几何却很棘手。Moxy的传感器首次捕捉到线索：X信号也许正把他们从纯粹的分子组装引向生物化学。
story.it: Poi apparve una firma organica familiare: CH₂O. Il suo schema era semplice, ma la geometria dei portali no. I sensori di Moxy registrarono il primo indizio che il Segnale X potesse condurre dall’assemblaggio molecolare puro verso la chimica biologica.
story.ko: A familiar organic signature appeared next: CH₂O. Its pattern was simple, but the portal geometry was not. Moxy’s sensors registered the first hint that the X Signal might be leading from pure molecular assembly toward biological chemistry.
story.ru: A familiar organic signature appeared next: CH₂O. Its pattern was simple, but the portal geometry was not. Moxy’s sensors registered the first hint that the X Signal might be leading from pure molecular assembly toward biological chemistry.

campaign.lesson: Navigation Mastery: combine Fusion, a long portal jump, and three independent direction arrows to assemble the five-atom SO₄ target signature by any legal route.

story.en: The SO₄ target signature closed the navigation series with a portal and three independent phase arrows. When the structure formed, the chamber floor rotated by a quarter turn, then stopped before the next experiment began. A new notice appeared: ROTATION CALIBRATION.
story.tr: SO₄ hedef imzası, bir portal ve birbirinden bağımsız üç faz okuyla navigasyon serisini kapattı. Yapı tamamlandığında kasa zemini çeyrek tur döndü, sonra yeni deney başlamadan durdu. Ekranda yeni bir uyarı belirdi: DÖNÜŞ KALİBRASYONU.
story.de: Die SO₄-Zielsignatur schloss die Navigationsserie mit einem Portal und drei unabhängigen Phasenpfeilen ab. Als die Struktur fertig war, drehte sich der Kammerboden um eine Vierteldrehung und stoppte vor dem nächsten Versuch. Ein neuer Hinweis erschien: ROTATIONSKALIBRIERUNG.
story.es: La firma objetivo SO₄ cerró la serie de navegación con un portal y tres flechas de fase independientes. Cuando se completó la estructura, el suelo de la cámara giró un cuarto de vuelta y se detuvo antes del siguiente experimento. Apareció un nuevo aviso: CALIBRACIÓN DE ROTACIÓN.
story.pt: A assinatura-alvo SO₄ encerrou a série de navegação com um portal e três setas de fase independentes. Quando a estrutura ficou pronta, o piso da câmara girou um quarto de volta e parou antes do próximo experimento. Surgiu um novo aviso: CALIBRAÇÃO DE ROTAÇÃO.
story.ja: SO₄の目標シグネチャは、ポータルと独立した三つの位相矢印でナビゲーション系列を締めくくった。構造が完成すると床が90度回転し、次の実験が始まる前に停止した。新しい表示が現れた――「回転キャリブレーション」。
story.fr: La signature cible SO₄ acheva la série de navigation avec un portail et trois flèches de phase indépendantes. Une fois la structure terminée, le sol pivota d’un quart de tour puis s’arrêta avant l’expérience suivante. Un nouvel avis apparut : CALIBRAGE DE ROTATION.
story.zh: SO₄目标特征用一个传送门和三个彼此独立的相位箭头结束了这一组导航试验。结构完成时，舱室地板旋转了四分之一圈，并在下一项实验开始前停下。屏幕出现新提示：旋转校准。
story.it: La firma obiettivo SO₄ chiuse la serie di navigazione con un portale e tre frecce di fase indipendenti. Quando la struttura fu completa, il pavimento della camera ruotò di un quarto di giro e si fermò prima dell’esperimento successivo. Comparve un nuovo avviso: CALIBRAZIONE DELLA ROTAZIONE.
story.ko: The SO₄ target signature closed the navigation series with a portal and three independent phase arrows. When the structure formed, the chamber floor rotated by a quarter turn, then stopped before the next experiment began. A new notice appeared: ROTATION CALIBRATION.
story.ru: The SO₄ target signature closed the navigation series with a portal and three independent phase arrows. When the structure formed, the chamber floor rotated by a quarter turn, then stopped before the next experiment began. A new notice appeared: ROTATION CALIBRATION.

campaign.lesson: Rotation Calibration: stop the rigid F–C–F module on the 90° pad, rotate it, then finish C₂F₄ anywhere on the board.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Oda faz haritasını çeviriyor; tanıdık kestirmeler artık aynı hizaya gelmiyor. C2F4 bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. C2F4 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Die Kammer dreht ihre Phasenkarte; vertraute Abkürzungen liegen nicht mehr auf einer Linie. C2F4 wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. La cámara gira su mapa de fase; los atajos conocidos ya no quedan alineados. C2F4 se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. A câmara gira seu mapa de fase; os atalhos conhecidos deixam de se alinhar. C2F4 se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 チャンバーが位相マップを回転させ、見慣れた近道が合わなくなる。 C2F4がこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. La chambre fait pivoter sa carte de phase ; les raccourcis familiers ne s’alignent plus. C2F4 devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 舱室旋转了相位图；熟悉的捷径不再对齐。 C2F4成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. La camera ruota la mappa di fase; le scorciatoie familiari non si allineano più. C2F4 diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. C2F4 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. C2F4 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Rotation mastery: preserve a rigid Fusion fragment, reorient it on the 90° pad, and complete the target anywhere on the board.

story.en: The first rotated fragment held its shape after the platform released it. Dr. Edward Atom noticed something else: the X signal became clearer only when the group faced the correct orientation. The Vault was not asking for a location — it was asking for geometry.
story.tr: İlk döndürülen parça platformdan ayrıldıktan sonra şeklini korudu. Dr. Edward Atom başka bir şeyi fark etti: X sinyali yalnızca grup doğru yöne baktığında netleşiyordu. Kasa bir konum istemiyordu — geometri istiyordu.
story.de: Das erste gedrehte Fragment behielt nach dem Verlassen der Plattform seine Form. Dr. Edward Atom bemerkte: Das X-Signal wurde nur bei korrekter Ausrichtung klarer. Der Tresor verlangte keinen Ort – sondern Geometrie.
story.es: El primer fragmento rotado conservó su forma al salir de la plataforma. Dr. Edward Atom observó que la señal X solo se aclaraba con la orientación correcta. La bóveda no pedía una posición: pedía geometría.
story.pt: O primeiro fragmento girado manteve a forma ao sair da plataforma. Dr. Edward Atom percebeu que o sinal X só ficava mais claro na orientação correta. A câmara não pedia um lugar — pedia geometria.
story.ja: 最初に回転させた断片は、パッドを離れても形を保った。Dr. Edward Atomは、X信号が正しい向きのときだけ鮮明になることに気づく。保管庫が求めていたのは場所ではなく、幾何学だった。
story.fr: Le premier fragment tourné conserva sa forme après avoir quitté la plateforme. Dr. Edward Atom remarqua que le signal X ne devenait plus net qu’avec la bonne orientation. La chambre ne demandait pas un lieu, mais une géométrie.
story.zh: 第一个旋转后的片段离开平台后仍保持形状。Dr. Edward Atom发现，只有朝向正确时X信号才会变清晰。共振库要求的不是位置，而是几何关系。
story.it: Il primo frammento ruotato mantenne la forma dopo aver lasciato la piattaforma. Dr. Edward Atom notò che il segnale X diventava più nitido solo con l’orientamento corretto. La Camera non chiedeva un luogo, ma una geometria.
story.ko: The first rotated fragment held its shape after the platform released it. Dr. Edward Atom noticed something else: the X signal became clearer only when the group faced the correct orientation. The Vault was not asking for a location — it was asking for geometry.
story.ru: The first rotated fragment held its shape after the platform released it. Dr. Edward Atom noticed something else: the X signal became clearer only when the group faced the correct orientation. The Vault was not asking for a location — it was asking for geometry.

campaign.lesson: Rotation mastery: preserve a rigid Fusion fragment, reorient it on the 90° pad, and complete the target anywhere on the board.

story.en: A narrow resonance channel appeared. One direction marker pulsed in time with the Rotation Pad. The signal was teaching a second rule: orientation and travel direction could cooperate without forcing a single solution path.
story.tr: Dar bir rezonans kanalı belirdi. Bir yön işareti Dönüş Platformu ile aynı ritimde titreşti. Sinyal ikinci bir kural öğretiyordu: yönelim ve hareket yönü, tek bir çözüm yolunu zorlamadan birlikte çalışabilirdi.
story.de: Ein schmaler Resonanzkanal erschien. Ein Richtungssymbol pulsierte im Takt mit dem Rotationsfeld. Das Signal lehrte eine zweite Regel: Ausrichtung und Bewegungsrichtung konnten zusammenarbeiten, ohne einen einzigen Lösungsweg zu erzwingen.
story.es: Apareció un canal estrecho de resonancia. Una flecha pulsó al ritmo de la plataforma. La señal enseñaba una segunda regla: orientación y dirección podían cooperar sin imponer una única solución.
story.pt: Surgiu um canal estreito de ressonância. Uma seta pulsou no ritmo da plataforma. O sinal ensinava uma segunda regra: orientação e direção podiam cooperar sem impor uma única solução.
story.ja: 細い共鳴チャネルが現れ、方向マーカーが回転パッドと同じリズムで脈動した。信号は第二の規則を示していた。向きと進行方向は、解法を一つに固定せず協力できる。
story.fr: Un étroit canal de résonance apparut. Une flèche pulsa au rythme de la plateforme. Le signal enseignait une seconde règle : orientation et direction pouvaient coopérer sans imposer une solution unique.
story.zh: 一条狭窄的共振通道出现了，方向标记与旋转平台同步脉动。信号正在教授第二条规则：朝向和移动方向可以协同，却不必强迫唯一解。
story.it: Comparve uno stretto canale di risonanza. Una freccia pulsava al ritmo della piattaforma. Il segnale insegnava una seconda regola: orientamento e direzione potevano collaborare senza imporre una sola soluzione.
story.ko: A narrow resonance channel appeared. One direction marker pulsed in time with the Rotation Pad. The signal was teaching a second rule: orientation and travel direction could cooperate without forcing a single solution path.
story.ru: A narrow resonance channel appeared. One direction marker pulsed in time with the Rotation Pad. The signal was teaching a second rule: orientation and travel direction could cooperate without forcing a single solution path.

campaign.lesson: Rotation mastery: preserve a rigid Fusion fragment, reorient it on the 90° pad, and complete the target anywhere on the board.

story.en: The Vault answered with a phosphorus pattern. Every successful rotation sharpened the same distant pulse. Null stopped calling it noise. Something beyond the laboratory was deliberately checking whether they could preserve structure while changing orientation.
story.tr: Kasa fosforlu bir desenle karşılık verdi. Her başarılı dönüş aynı uzak darbeyi daha da belirginleştirdi. Null artık buna gürültü demiyordu. Laboratuvarın ötesindeki bir şey, yön değişirken yapıyı koruyup koruyamadıklarını bilinçli olarak sınavdan geçiriyordu.
story.de: Der Tresor antwortete mit einem Phosphormuster. Jede erfolgreiche Drehung schärfte denselben fernen Puls. Null nannte es nicht länger Rauschen. Etwas jenseits des Labors prüfte gezielt, ob sie Struktur beim Drehen bewahren konnten.
story.es: La bóveda respondió con un patrón de fósforo. Cada rotación correcta hacía más nítido el mismo pulso lejano. Null dejó de llamarlo ruido. Algo fuera del laboratorio comprobaba si podían conservar la estructura al cambiar la orientación.
story.pt: A câmara respondeu com um padrão de fósforo. Cada rotação correta tornava o mesmo pulso distante mais nítido. Null parou de chamá-lo de ruído. Algo além do laboratório testava se eles preservavam a estrutura ao mudar a orientação.
story.ja: 保管庫はリンを含むパターンで応答した。回転に成功するたび、遠い同じパルスが鮮明になる。Nullはもう雑音とは呼ばなかった。研究室の外の何かが、向きを変えても構造を保てるか意図的に試していた。
story.fr: La chambre répondit par un motif au phosphore. Chaque rotation réussie rendait le même signal lointain plus net. Null cessa de parler de bruit. Quelque chose au-delà du laboratoire testait volontairement leur capacité à préserver la structure en changeant son orientation.
story.zh: 共振库用一个含磷图样作出回应。每次成功旋转都会让同一个遥远脉冲更加清晰。Null不再称它为噪声。实验室之外的某种存在正在有意识地测试他们能否在改变朝向时保持结构。
