campaign.lesson: Prebuilt Module III: use a four-atom anchor fragment and place three free atoms around it. The module moves as one rigid unit.

story.en: The next chamber stabilized an even larger fragment. Dr. Edward Atom tapped it twice: “Four atoms already behaving? I should frame this moment.” Use the ready module as the anchor and finish acetaldehyde without dismantling it.
story.tr: Sıradaki oda daha da büyük bir parçayı kararlı hâlde sundu. Dr. Edward Atom iki kez tıklattı: “Dört atom şimdiden uslu mu? Bu anı çerçeveletmeliyim.” Hazır modülü ankraj olarak kullan ve onu bozmadan asetaldehiti tamamla.
story.de: Die nächste Kammer stabilisierte ein noch größeres Fragment. Dr. Edward Atom klopfte zweimal darauf: „Vier Atome benehmen sich schon? Diesen Moment sollte ich einrahmen.“ Nutze das fertige Modul als Anker und vervollständige Acetaldehyd, ohne es zu zerlegen.
story.es: La siguiente cámara estabilizó un fragmento aún mayor. Dr. Edward Atom lo golpeó dos veces: «¿Cuatro átomos ya se portan bien? Debería enmarcar este momento». Usa el módulo preparado como ancla y completa el acetaldehído sin desmontarlo.
story.pt: A sala seguinte estabilizou um fragmento ainda maior. Dr. Edward Atom bateu nele duas vezes: “Quatro átomos já se comportando? Eu devia emoldurar este momento.” Use o módulo pronto como âncora e complete o acetaldeído sem desmontá-lo.
story.ja: 次の部屋では、さらに大きな断片が安定化されていた。Dr. Edward Atomは二度たたいた。「4つの原子がもうお行儀よくしてる？ この瞬間を額に入れたいね。」完成済みモジュールを土台にして、崩さずアセトアルデヒドを完成させよう。
story.fr: La salle suivante stabilisa un fragment encore plus grand. Dr. Edward Atom tapa dessus deux fois : « Quatre atomes déjà sages ? Je devrais encadrer ce moment. » Utilise le module prêt comme ancrage et termine l’acétaldéhyde sans le démonter.
story.zh: 下一个房间稳定了一个更大的片段。Dr. Edward Atom敲了两下：“四个原子已经这么听话？我应该把这一刻裱起来。”把现成模块当作锚点，在不拆散它的情况下完成乙醛。
story.it: La sala successiva stabilizzò un frammento ancora più grande. Dr. Edward Atom lo toccò due volte: «Quattro atomi già disciplinati? Dovrei incorniciare questo momento.» Usa il modulo pronto come ancora e completa l’acetaldeide senza smontarlo.
story.ko: The next chamber stabilized an even larger fragment. Dr. Edward Atom tapped it twice: “Four atoms already behaving? I should frame this moment.” Use the ready module as the anchor and finish acetaldehyde without dismantling it.
story.ru: The next chamber stabilized an even larger fragment. Dr. Edward Atom tapped it twice: “Four atoms already behaving? I should frame this moment.” Use the ready module as the anchor and finish acetaldehyde without dismantling it.

campaign.lesson: Dual Prebuilt Modules: coordinate two independent rigid fragments, then add the remaining atom. Neither fragment can be dismantled.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Moxy ikinci bir yankı yakalıyor ve yaklaşma sırasını tamamen değiştiriyor. C2H4Br2O bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Moxy detects a second echo, forcing a different order of approach. C2H4Br2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Moxy erkennt ein zweites Echo und erzwingt damit eine andere Reihenfolge der Annäherung. C2H4Br2O wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. Moxy detecta un segundo eco, obligando a cambiar el orden de aproximación. C2H4Br2O se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. Moxy detecta um segundo eco, obrigando a mudar a ordem de aproximação. C2H4Br2O se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 Moxyが第二の反響を検出し、接近の順番を変えざるを得なくなる。 C2H4Br2Oがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. Moxy détecte un second écho, imposant un nouvel ordre d’approche. C2H4Br2O devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 Moxy探测到第二道回声，迫使接近顺序发生改变。 C2H4Br2O成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. Moxy rileva una seconda eco, imponendo un diverso ordine di avvicinamento. C2H4Br2O diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Moxy detects a second echo, forcing a different order of approach. C2H4Br2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Moxy detects a second echo, forcing a different order of approach. C2H4Br2O becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Dual Module Synthesis: join two ready rigid fragments and place one final free atom. Correct target topology wins anywhere on the board.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Oda faz haritasını çeviriyor; tanıdık kestirmeler artık aynı hizaya gelmiyor. C2H4O2 bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. C2H4O2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Die Kammer dreht ihre Phasenkarte; vertraute Abkürzungen liegen nicht mehr auf einer Linie. C2H4O2 wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. La cámara gira su mapa de fase; los atajos conocidos ya no quedan alineados. C2H4O2 se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. A câmara gira seu mapa de fase; os atalhos conhecidos deixam de se alinhar. C2H4O2 se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 チャンバーが位相マップを回転させ、見慣れた近道が合わなくなる。 C2H4O2がこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. La chambre fait pivoter sa carte de phase ; les raccourcis familiers ne s’alignent plus. C2H4O2 devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 舱室旋转了相位图；熟悉的捷径不再对齐。 C2H4O2成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. La camera ruota la mappa di fase; le scorciatoie familiari non si allineano più. C2H4O2 diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. C2H4O2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. C2H4O2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Rift Portal: crossing the black-violet portal triggers an immediate warp to its twin, then the atom continues sliding in the SAME direction. A Rift pair triggers at most once per move to prevent loops.

story.en: A black-violet fracture opened across the floor. Dr. Edward Atom leaned back. “That is not a portal. That is a portal with attitude.” The Rift Portal grabs an atom the instant it crosses the tile, throws it to its twin, and the atom keeps sliding in the same direction.
story.tr: Zeminde siyah-mor bir yarık açıldı. Dr. Edward Atom geriye çekildi. “Bu portal değil. Bu, tavırlı bir portal.” Rift Portal, atom karo üzerinden geçtiği anda onu yakalar, eşine fırlatır ve atom aynı yönde kaymaya devam eder.
story.de: Ein schwarz-violetter Riss öffnete sich im Boden. Dr. Edward Atom wich zurück. „Das ist kein Portal. Das ist ein Portal mit Attitüde.“ Das Rift-Portal erfasst ein Atom beim Überqueren, schleudert es zum Zwilling und lässt es in derselben Richtung weitergleiten.
story.es: Una grieta negro-violeta se abrió en el suelo. Dr. Edward Atom se echó atrás. «Eso no es un portal. Es un portal con actitud». El Portal de Fisura atrapa un átomo al cruzarlo, lo lanza a su gemelo y el átomo sigue deslizándose en la misma dirección.
story.pt: Uma fenda preta e violeta se abriu no chão. Dr. Edward Atom recuou. “Isso não é um portal. É um portal com atitude.” O Portal de Fenda captura o átomo ao cruzar o piso, lança-o ao portal gêmeo e ele continua deslizando na mesma direção.
story.ja: 床に黒紫の亀裂が開いた。Dr. Edward Atomは身を引いた。「これはポータルじゃない。態度のあるポータルだ。」リフトポータルは原子がマスを通過した瞬間に捕まえ、対になる出口へ飛ばし、そのまま同じ方向へ滑らせる。
story.fr: Une fracture noir-violet s’ouvrit dans le sol. Dr. Edward Atom recula : « Ce n’est pas un portail. C’est un portail avec du caractère. » Le Portail de Faille attrape un atome dès qu’il traverse la case, l’envoie vers son jumeau et l’atome continue de glisser dans la même direction.
story.zh: 地板上裂开了一道黑紫色裂隙。Dr. Edward Atom往后一仰：“这不是普通传送门，这是有脾气的传送门。”裂隙传送门会在原子经过格子的瞬间抓住它，把它甩到另一端，并让原子沿原方向继续滑动。
story.it: Una frattura nero-viola si aprì sul pavimento. Dr. Edward Atom si tirò indietro: «Quello non è un portale. È un portale con carattere.» Il Portale Rift cattura un atomo appena attraversa la casella, lo lancia al gemello e l’atomo continua a scivolare nella stessa direzione.
story.ko: A black-violet fracture opened across the floor. Dr. Edward Atom leaned back. “That is not a portal. That is a portal with attitude.” The Rift Portal grabs an atom the instant it crosses the tile, throws it to its twin, and the atom keeps sliding in the same direction.
story.ru: A black-violet fracture opened across the floor. Dr. Edward Atom leaned back. “That is not a portal. That is a portal with attitude.” The Rift Portal grabs an atom the instant it crosses the tile, throws it to its twin, and the atom keeps sliding in the same direction.

campaign.lesson: Rift + One-Way: crossing a Rift keeps the slide direction; one-way tiles still enforce their arrow direction.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Dr. Null bir faz uyumsuzluğu buluyor; rota dıştan içe yeniden kurulmak zorunda. C2H3FO bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Dr. Null finds a phase mismatch; the route must be rebuilt from the outside in. C2H3FO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Dr. Null entdeckt eine Phasenabweichung; die Route muss von außen nach innen neu aufgebaut werden. C2H3FO wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. Dr. Null encuentra un desfase; la ruta debe reconstruirse de fuera hacia dentro. C2H3FO se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. Dr. Null encontra um descompasso de fase; a rota precisa ser refeita de fora para dentro. C2H3FO se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 Dr. Nullが位相のずれを見つけ、ルートを外側から内側へ組み直す必要が生じる。 C2H3FOがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. Dr. Null détecte un décalage de phase ; la route doit être reconstruite de l’extérieur vers l’intérieur. C2H3FO devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 Dr. Null发现相位不匹配；路线必须从外向内重新构建。 C2H3FO成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. Dr. Null trova uno sfasamento; il percorso deve essere ricostruito dall’esterno verso l’interno. C2H3FO diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Dr. Null finds a phase mismatch; the route must be rebuilt from the outside in. C2H3FO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. Dr. Null finds a phase mismatch; the route must be rebuilt from the outside in. C2H3FO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Rift + Fragile: a fragile atom may use the Rift, but repeated hard stops still count toward shattering.

story.en: A brittle sample waited beside the Rift. Dr. Edward Atom lowered his voice. “Teleportation does not make glass less dramatic.” Route the fragile atom cleanly; the Rift changes where it travels, not how many hard impacts it can survive.
story.tr: Rift’in yanında kırılgan bir örnek bekliyordu. Dr. Edward Atom sesini alçalttı. “Işınlanmak camın dramını azaltmıyor.” Kırılgan atomu temiz bir rotayla götür; Rift nereye gittiğini değiştirir, kaç sert darbeye dayanacağını değil.
story.de: Neben dem Rift wartete eine zerbrechliche Probe. Dr. Edward Atom sprach leiser. „Teleportation macht Glas nicht weniger dramatisch.“ Führe das fragile Atom sauber; der Rift verändert den Weg, nicht die Zahl der harten Stöße, die es verträgt.
story.es: Una muestra frágil esperaba junto a la Fisura. Dr. Edward Atom bajó la voz. «Teletransportarse no hace que el vidrio sea menos dramático». Traza una ruta limpia: la Fisura cambia el recorrido, no los golpes fuertes que puede soportar.
story.pt: Uma amostra frágil esperava ao lado da Fenda. Dr. Edward Atom baixou a voz. “Teletransporte não deixa o vidro menos dramático.” Conduza o átomo frágil com cuidado; a Fenda muda o caminho, não a quantidade de impactos que ele suporta.
story.ja: リフトのそばに壊れやすい試料が待っていた。Dr. Edward Atomは声を落とした。「テレポートしてもガラスの繊細さは変わらない。」壊れやすい原子を丁寧に運ぼう。リフトは経路を変えるが、耐えられる強い衝撃の回数は変えない。
story.fr: Un échantillon fragile attendait près de la Faille. Dr. Edward Atom baissa la voix : « La téléportation ne rend pas le verre moins théâtral. » Guide l’atome fragile proprement ; la Faille change son trajet, pas le nombre de chocs qu’il supporte.
story.zh: 一个易碎样品正等在裂隙旁。Dr. Edward Atom压低声音：“传送并不会让玻璃变得不娇气。”让易碎原子走一条干净路线；裂隙改变的是路径，不是它能承受的猛烈撞击次数。
story.it: Un campione fragile attendeva accanto al Rift. Dr. Edward Atom abbassò la voce: «Il teletrasporto non rende il vetro meno teatrale.» Guida con cura l’atomo fragile: il Rift cambia il percorso, non il numero di urti che può sopportare.
story.ko: A brittle sample waited beside the Rift. Dr. Edward Atom lowered his voice. “Teleportation does not make glass less dramatic.” Route the fragile atom cleanly; the Rift changes where it travels, not how many hard impacts it can survive.
story.ru: A brittle sample waited beside the Rift. Dr. Edward Atom lowered his voice. “Teleportation does not make glass less dramatic.” Route the fragile atom cleanly; the Rift changes where it travels, not how many hard impacts it can survive.

campaign.lesson: Rift + Pressure Door: use a pressure plate to control the door while routing another atom through Rift space.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Uyuyan bir kanal açılıyor ve hangi koridorun önce kullanılacağını değiştiriyor. CH3NO2 bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. A dormant channel wakes up and changes which corridor matters first. CH3NO2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Ein ruhender Kanal erwacht und verändert, welcher Korridor zuerst zählt. CH3NO2 wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. Un canal inactivo despierta y cambia qué corredor importa primero. CH3NO2 se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. Um canal adormecido desperta e muda qual corredor deve vir primeiro. CH3NO2 se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 休止していた経路が起動し、最初に使うべき通路が変わる。 CH3NO2がこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. Un canal dormant se réveille et change le couloir à privilégier en premier. CH3NO2 devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 一条休眠通道被唤醒，改变了首先需要处理的走廊。 CH3NO2成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. Un canale inattivo si riattiva e cambia quale corridoio conta per primo. CH3NO2 diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. A dormant channel wakes up and changes which corridor matters first. CH3NO2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. A dormant channel wakes up and changes which corridor matters first. CH3NO2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Rift + Moving Wall: the wall advances after each move, so plan both the teleport route and the board's next geometry.

story.en: The fracture chamber started rearranging itself after every move. Dr. Edward Atom stared at the powered wall. “Good. The room is thinking now. That seems fair.” Plan one move ahead: the Rift keeps direction, while the moving wall changes the next lane.
story.tr: Yarık odası artık her hamleden sonra kendini yeniden düzenliyordu. Dr. Edward Atom güçlendirilmiş duvara baktı. “Güzel. Oda da düşünmeye başladı. Çok adil.” Bir hamle sonrasını planla: Rift yönü korurken hareketli duvar bir sonraki koridoru değiştirir.
story.de: Die Risskammer ordnete sich nun nach jedem Zug neu. Dr. Edward Atom starrte auf die angetriebene Wand. „Gut. Jetzt denkt der Raum auch noch mit. Sehr fair.“ Plane einen Zug voraus: Der Rift behält die Richtung, die bewegliche Wand verändert die nächste Bahn.
story.es: La sala de la fisura empezó a reorganizarse tras cada movimiento. Dr. Edward Atom miró la pared motorizada. «Bien. Ahora la habitación también piensa. Muy justo». Planifica un movimiento por adelantado: la Fisura conserva la dirección y la pared cambia el siguiente carril.
story.pt: A sala da fenda começou a se reorganizar depois de cada jogada. Dr. Edward Atom encarou a parede motorizada. “Ótimo. Agora a sala também pensa. Muito justo.” Planeje uma jogada à frente: a Fenda mantém a direção e a parede móvel altera a próxima passagem.
story.ja: 裂け目の部屋は一手ごとに配置を変え始めた。Dr. Edward Atomは動力壁を見つめた。「いいね。今度は部屋まで考えるらしい。実に公平だ。」一手先を読もう。リフトは方向を保ち、動く壁は次の通路を変える。
story.fr: La salle de la faille se mit à se réorganiser après chaque coup. Dr. Edward Atom fixa le mur motorisé : « Parfait. Maintenant la pièce réfléchit aussi. Très équitable. » Prévois un coup d’avance : la Faille conserve la direction, tandis que le mur mobile change la prochaine voie.
story.zh: 裂隙房间开始在每一步之后重新排列。Dr. Edward Atom盯着动力墙：“很好。现在房间也会思考了。真公平。”提前规划一步：裂隙保持移动方向，而移动墙会改变下一条通道。
story.it: La stanza della frattura iniziò a riordinarsi dopo ogni mossa. Dr. Edward Atom fissò la parete motorizzata: «Bene. Adesso pensa anche la stanza. Molto equo.» Pianifica una mossa in anticipo: il Rift mantiene la direzione, mentre la parete mobile cambia la corsia successiva.
story.ko: The fracture chamber started rearranging itself after every move. Dr. Edward Atom stared at the powered wall. “Good. The room is thinking now. That seems fair.” Plan one move ahead: the Rift keeps direction, while the moving wall changes the next lane.
story.ru: The fracture chamber started rearranging itself after every move. Dr. Edward Atom stared at the powered wall. “Good. The room is thinking now. That seems fair.” Plan one move ahead: the Rift keeps direction, while the moving wall changes the next lane.

campaign.lesson: Rift + Breakable Wall/Hammer option: the Rift keeps direction; Lab Tools can help without replacing the puzzle.

story.en: The Rift chamber grew cracked walls. Dr. Edward Atom tapped the Lab Tools tray. “The Hammer is available if a breakable wall ruins your route. I am not telling you which wall—science still needs some dignity.” Use the Rift cleanly and treat the Hammer as an option, not an answer.
story.tr: Rift odasında çatlak duvarlar belirdi. Dr. Edward Atom Lab Araçları tepsisine dokundu. “Kırılabilir bir duvar rotanı bozarsa Çekiç kullanılabilir. Hangi duvar olduğunu söylemiyorum—bilimin biraz gururu kalsın.” Rift’i temiz kullan; Çekici cevap değil, seçenek olarak gör.
story.de: In der Rift-Kammer tauchten rissige Wände auf. Dr. Edward Atom tippte auf die Laborwerkzeuge. „Wenn eine zerbrechliche Wand deine Route stört, ist der Hammer verfügbar. Welche Wand? Das verrate ich nicht.“ Nutze den Rift sauber und den Hammer als Option, nicht als Lösung.
story.es: Aparecieron paredes agrietadas en la cámara de la Fisura. Dr. Edward Atom señaló las Herramientas de laboratorio. «Si una pared rompible estropea tu ruta, tienes el Martillo. No diré cuál.» Usa la Fisura con precisión y el Martillo como opción, no como respuesta.
story.pt: Paredes rachadas surgiram na sala da Fenda. Dr. Edward Atom apontou para as Ferramentas de laboratório. “Se uma parede quebrável atrapalhar sua rota, o Martelo está disponível. Não vou dizer qual.” Use a Fenda com precisão e o Martelo como opção, não como resposta.
story.ja: リフト室に壊せる壁が現れた。Dr. Edward Atomはラボツールを指した。「壊せる壁がルートを邪魔するならハンマーは使える。でもどの壁かは教えないよ。」リフトを丁寧に使い、ハンマーは答えではなく選択肢として考えよう。
story.fr: Des murs fissurés apparurent dans la salle de la Faille. Dr. Edward Atom montra les Outils de labo : « Si un mur destructible gêne ta route, le Marteau est disponible. Je ne dirai pas lequel. » Utilise la Faille proprement et le Marteau comme option, pas comme réponse.
story.zh: 裂隙房间里出现了可破坏的裂墙。Dr. Edward Atom指了指实验室工具：“如果某面可破坏墙挡了路线，可以用锤子。至于哪一面，我不说。”把锤子当作选择，不是答案。
story.it: Nella stanza del Rift comparvero pareti crepate. Dr. Edward Atom indicò gli Strumenti da laboratorio: «Se una parete distruttibile rovina il percorso, puoi usare il Martello. Non dirò quale.» Usa il Rift con precisione e il Martello come opzione, non come risposta.
story.ko: The Rift chamber grew cracked walls. Dr. Edward Atom tapped the Lab Tools tray. “The Hammer is available if a breakable wall ruins your route. I am not telling you which wall—science still needs some dignity.” Use the Rift cleanly and treat the Hammer as an option, not an answer.
story.ru: The Rift chamber grew cracked walls. Dr. Edward Atom tapped the Lab Tools tray. “The Hammer is available if a breakable wall ruins your route. I am not telling you which wall—science still needs some dignity.” Use the Rift cleanly and treat the Hammer as an option, not an answer.

campaign.lesson: Frozen + Fire + Zombie refresher: thaw and cure before zombie spread creates a dead-end.

story.en: The Rift fell silent, but an old quarantine alarm woke up: Frozen, Fire and Zombie atoms were back together. Dr. Edward Atom grinned. “A reunion episode. Nobody asked for it.” Remember that heat can thaw a frozen problem before the infection spreads.
story.tr: Rift sustu ama eski karantina alarmı uyandı: Frozen, Fire ve Zombie atomları yeniden aynı odadaydı. Dr. Edward Atom sırıttı. “Buluşma bölümü. Kimse istemedi ama geldi.” Enfeksiyon yayılmadan önce ısının donmuş sorunu çözebileceğini hatırla.
story.de: Der Rift schwieg, doch ein alter Quarantänealarm erwachte: Frozen-, Fire- und Zombie-Atome waren wieder zusammen. Dr. Edward Atom grinste. „Eine Reunion-Folge. Niemand hat darum gebeten.“ Denk daran: Hitze kann ein gefrorenes Problem auftauen, bevor es sich ausbreitet.
story.es: La Fisura quedó en silencio, pero despertó una vieja alarma de cuarentena: Frozen, Fire y Zombie volvían a compartir sala. Dr. Edward Atom sonrió. «Episodio de reunión. Nadie lo pidió.» Recuerda que el calor puede descongelar el problema antes de que se propague.
story.pt: A Fenda ficou em silêncio, mas um velho alarme de quarentena acordou: Frozen, Fire e Zombie voltaram à mesma sala. Dr. Edward Atom sorriu. “Episódio de reencontro. Ninguém pediu.” Lembre que o calor pode descongelar o problema antes que ele se espalhe.
story.ja: リフトは静まったが、古い隔離警報が再起動した。Frozen、Fire、Zombieが同じ部屋に戻ってきた。Dr. Edward Atomは笑った。「再会回だね。誰も頼んでないけど。」感染が広がる前に、熱で凍結を解けることを思い出そう。
story.fr: La Faille se tut, mais une vieille alarme de quarantaine se réveilla : Frozen, Fire et Zombie étaient de retour ensemble. Dr. Edward Atom sourit : « Épisode retrouvailles. Personne ne l’a demandé. » Souviens-toi que la chaleur peut dégeler le problème avant sa propagation.
story.zh: 裂隙安静了下来，但旧隔离警报又响了：Frozen、Fire和Zombie原子重新同场。Dr. Edward Atom笑道：“重聚篇，没人点播。”记住，在感染扩散前，热量可以先解除冻结。
story.it: Il Rift tacque, ma si riaccese un vecchio allarme di quarantena: Frozen, Fire e Zombie erano di nuovo insieme. Dr. Edward Atom sorrise: «Episodio reunion. Nessuno l’ha chiesto.» Ricorda che il calore può scongelare il problema prima che si diffonda.
story.ko: The Rift fell silent, but an old quarantine alarm woke up: Frozen, Fire and Zombie atoms were back together. Dr. Edward Atom grinned. “A reunion episode. Nobody asked for it.” Remember that heat can thaw a frozen problem before the infection spreads.
story.ru: The Rift fell silent, but an old quarantine alarm woke up: Frozen, Fire and Zombie atoms were back together. Dr. Edward Atom grinned. “A reunion episode. Nobody asked for it.” Remember that heat can thaw a frozen problem before the infection spreads.

campaign.lesson: Sticky refresher: after bonding, the sticky pair moves as one rigid unit.

story.en: A sticky sample returned from storage. Dr. Edward Atom lifted one eyebrow. “Ah, chemistry’s clingy friend.” Once the Sticky bond forms, the pair moves together—plan the contact before you commit.
story.tr: Depodan yapışkan bir örnek geri döndü. Dr. Edward Atom kaşını kaldırdı. “Kimyanın ayrılmak istemeyen dostu.” Sticky bağı oluşunca çift birlikte hareket eder; teması kurmadan önce rotayı planla.
story.de: Eine klebrige Probe kam aus dem Lager zurück. Dr. Edward Atom hob eine Augenbraue. „Ah, der anhängliche Freund der Chemie.“ Sobald die Sticky-Bindung entsteht, bewegt sich das Paar gemeinsam—plane den Kontakt vorher.
story.es: Una muestra pegajosa volvió del almacén. Dr. Edward Atom alzó una ceja. «Ah, el amigo inseparable de la química». Cuando se forma el enlace Sticky, la pareja se mueve junta; planea el contacto antes.
story.pt: Uma amostra pegajosa voltou do depósito. Dr. Edward Atom ergueu a sobrancelha. “Ah, o amigo grudento da química.” Depois que a ligação Sticky se forma, o par se move junto; planeje o contato antes.
story.ja: 保管庫からSticky試料が戻ってきた。Dr. Edward Atomは眉を上げた。「化学のくっつきたがり屋だ。」Sticky結合ができると2つは一緒に動く。接触させる前にルートを考えよう。
story.fr: Un échantillon collant revint du stockage. Dr. Edward Atom leva un sourcil : « Ah, l’ami pot-de-colle de la chimie. » Une fois la liaison Sticky formée, la paire se déplace ensemble ; planifie le contact avant.
story.zh: 一个Sticky样品从仓库回来了。Dr. Edward Atom挑眉：“化学里最黏人的朋友。”一旦形成Sticky连接，两颗原子会一起移动；接触前先规划。
story.it: Un campione Sticky tornò dal deposito. Dr. Edward Atom alzò un sopracciglio: «Ah, l’amico appiccicoso della chimica.» Quando si forma il legame Sticky, la coppia si muove insieme: pianifica il contatto prima.
story.ko: A sticky sample returned from storage. Dr. Edward Atom lifted one eyebrow. “Ah, chemistry’s clingy friend.” Once the Sticky bond forms, the pair moves together—plan the contact before you commit.
story.ru: A sticky sample returned from storage. Dr. Edward Atom lifted one eyebrow. “Ah, chemistry’s clingy friend.” Once the Sticky bond forms, the pair moves together—plan the contact before you commit.

campaign.lesson: Lightning + Frozen refresher: conductive contact can transmit charge and thaw a frozen atom.

story.tr: Rezonans Kasası içinde yeni bir iz beliriyor. Oda faz haritasını çeviriyor; tanıdık kestirmeler artık aynı hizaya gelmiyor. SiH3ClO bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. SiH3ClO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Im Resonanz-Tresor taucht eine neue Spur auf. Die Kammer dreht ihre Phasenkarte; vertraute Abkürzungen liegen nicht mehr auf einer Linie. SiH3ClO wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Aparece una nueva traza de resonancia dentro de la Bóveda. La cámara gira su mapa de fase; los atajos conocidos ya no quedan alineados. SiH3ClO se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. A câmara gira seu mapa de fase; os atalhos conhecidos deixam de se alinhar. SiH3ClO se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: 共鳴保管庫の内部に新しい痕跡が現れる。 チャンバーが位相マップを回転させ、見慣れた近道が合わなくなる。 SiH3ClOがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Une nouvelle trace de résonance apparaît dans la Chambre. La chambre fait pivoter sa carte de phase ; les raccourcis familiers ne s’alignent plus. SiH3ClO devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: 共振库内部浮现出一条新的轨迹。 舱室旋转了相位图；熟悉的捷径不再对齐。 SiH3ClO成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Nella Camera di Risonanza emerge una nuova traccia. La camera ruota la mappa di fase; le scorciatoie familiari non si allineano più. SiH3ClO diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. SiH3ClO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The chamber rotates its phase map; familiar shortcuts no longer line up. SiH3ClO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: One-Way + Fragile refresher: respect arrow flow while managing fragile impact count.

story.en: A one-way lane narrowed beside a Fragile sample. Dr. Edward Atom whispered, “Direction and impact count. Two tiny details capable of ruining an excellent afternoon.” Respect the arrow and avoid unnecessary hard stops.
story.tr: Fragile örneğin yanında tek yönlü bir şerit daraldı. Dr. Edward Atom fısıldadı: “Yön ve darbe sayısı. Harika bir öğleden sonrayı bozabilecek iki küçük ayrıntı.” Oka uy ve gereksiz sert duruşlardan kaçın.
story.de: Neben einer Fragile-Probe verengte sich eine Einbahnspur. Dr. Edward Atom flüsterte: „Richtung und Stoßzahl. Zwei Kleinigkeiten, die einen schönen Nachmittag ruinieren.“ Beachte den Pfeil und vermeide unnötige harte Stopps.
story.es: Un carril de sentido único se estrechó junto a una muestra Fragile. Dr. Edward Atom susurró: «Dirección y número de impactos. Dos detalles capaces de arruinar una tarde excelente». Respeta la flecha y evita paradas duras innecesarias.
story.pt: Uma faixa de mão única se estreitou ao lado de uma amostra Fragile. Dr. Edward Atom sussurrou: “Direção e contagem de impactos. Dois detalhes capazes de estragar uma ótima tarde.” Respeite a seta e evite paradas bruscas desnecessárias.
story.ja: Fragile試料の横で一方通行レーンが狭くなった。Dr. Edward Atomはささやいた。「方向と衝撃回数。良い午後を台無しにする小さな2項目だ。」矢印を守り、不要な強い停止を避けよう。
story.fr: Une voie à sens unique se resserra près d’un échantillon Fragile. Dr. Edward Atom murmura : « Direction et nombre de chocs. Deux petits détails capables de ruiner une excellente après-midi. » Respecte la flèche et évite les arrêts brutaux inutiles.
story.zh: Fragile样品旁的单向通道变窄了。Dr. Edward Atom低声说：“方向和撞击次数——两个足以毁掉完美下午的小细节。”遵守箭头，避免不必要的硬碰撞。
story.it: Una corsia a senso unico si strinse accanto a un campione Fragile. Dr. Edward Atom sussurrò: «Direzione e numero di urti. Due piccoli dettagli capaci di rovinare un ottimo pomeriggio.» Rispetta la freccia ed evita arresti duri inutili.
story.ko: A one-way lane narrowed beside a Fragile sample. Dr. Edward Atom whispered, “Direction and impact count. Two tiny details capable of ruining an excellent afternoon.” Respect the arrow and avoid unnecessary hard stops.
story.ru: A one-way lane narrowed beside a Fragile sample. Dr. Edward Atom whispered, “Direction and impact count. Two tiny details capable of ruining an excellent afternoon.” Respect the arrow and avoid unnecessary hard stops.

campaign.lesson: Prebuilt Module refresher: keep the starting rigid module intact and attach the free atoms.

story.en: The Rift shutters closed for a calibration chamber, revealing a Prebuilt Module already locked together. Dr. Edward Atom smiled. “No teleporting furniture today.” Keep the rigid module intact and add the remaining atoms around it.
story.tr: Kalibrasyon odasında Rift kepenkleri kapandı ve önceden kilitlenmiş bir Hazır Molekül Modülü ortaya çıktı. Dr. Edward Atom gülümsedi. “Bugün mobilyaları ışınlamıyoruz.” Rijit modülü bozmadan tut ve kalan atomları etrafına ekle.
story.de: Für eine Kalibrierkammer schlossen sich die Rift-Schotten; ein vorgefertigtes Modul war bereits starr verbunden. Dr. Edward Atom lächelte. „Heute teleportieren wir keine Möbel.“ Halte das Modul intakt und ergänze die übrigen Atome.
story.es: Las compuertas de la Fisura se cerraron para calibración y apareció un Módulo Preparado ya rígido. Dr. Edward Atom sonrió. «Hoy no teletransportamos muebles». Mantén el módulo intacto y añade los átomos restantes.
story.pt: As comportas da Fenda fecharam para calibração e revelaram um Módulo Pronto já rígido. Dr. Edward Atom sorriu. “Hoje não vamos teletransportar móveis.” Mantenha o módulo intacto e adicione os átomos restantes.
story.ja: 較正室ではリフトのシャッターが閉じ、最初から固定されたPrebuilt Moduleが現れた。Dr. Edward Atomは笑った。「今日は家具をテレポートしない。」剛体モジュールを崩さず、残りの原子を加えよう。
story.fr: Les volets de la Faille se fermèrent pour la calibration et révélèrent un Module préassemblé déjà rigide. Dr. Edward Atom sourit : « Pas de meubles téléportés aujourd’hui. » Garde le module intact et ajoute les atomes restants.
story.zh: 校准室关闭了裂隙闸门，一个已锁定的预组装分子模块出现了。Dr. Edward Atom笑道：“今天不传送家具。”保持刚性模块完整，再把其余原子接上。
story.it: Le paratie del Rift si chiusero per la calibrazione, rivelando un Modulo Preassemblato già rigido. Dr. Edward Atom sorrise: «Niente mobili teletrasportati oggi.» Mantieni intatto il modulo e aggiungi gli atomi restanti.
story.ko: The Rift shutters closed for a calibration chamber, revealing a Prebuilt Module already locked together. Dr. Edward Atom smiled. “No teleporting furniture today.” Keep the rigid module intact and add the remaining atoms around it.
story.ru: The Rift shutters closed for a calibration chamber, revealing a Prebuilt Module already locked together. Dr. Edward Atom smiled. “No teleporting furniture today.” Keep the rigid module intact and add the remaining atoms around it.

campaign.lesson: Linked refresher: linked atoms travel together; both paths must remain clear.

story.en: A Linked pair arrived in a chamber with no Rift transit. Dr. Edward Atom pointed at both atoms. “They signed the same travel contract.” Move the pair as a coordinated unit and make sure both sides have room.
story.tr: Linked bir çift Rift geçişi olmayan bir odaya geldi. Dr. Edward Atom iki atomu da gösterdi. “Aynı seyahat sözleşmesini imzalamışlar.” Çifti koordineli bir birim gibi hareket ettir; iki tarafın da yolu açık olsun.
story.de: Ein Linked-Paar kam in eine Kammer ohne Rift-Transit. Dr. Edward Atom zeigte auf beide Atome. „Sie haben denselben Reisevertrag unterschrieben.“ Bewege sie koordiniert und achte darauf, dass beide Seiten Platz haben.
story.es: Una pareja Linked llegó a una cámara sin tránsito de Fisura. Dr. Edward Atom señaló ambos átomos. «Firmaron el mismo contrato de viaje». Muévelos como una unidad coordinada y deja espacio para ambos.
story.pt: Um par Linked chegou a uma sala sem trânsito de Fenda. Dr. Edward Atom apontou para os dois átomos. “Eles assinaram o mesmo contrato de viagem.” Mova o par como uma unidade coordenada e garanta espaço para os dois.
story.ja: Linkedペアがリフト通過のない部屋に到着した。Dr. Edward Atomは2つの原子を指した。「同じ旅行契約に署名したらしい。」2つを協調して動かし、両側に十分な空間を確保しよう。
story.fr: Une paire Linked arriva dans une salle sans transit par Faille. Dr. Edward Atom montra les deux atomes : « Ils ont signé le même contrat de voyage. » Déplace la paire de façon coordonnée et laisse de la place aux deux côtés.
story.zh: 一对Linked原子进入了没有裂隙传送的房间。Dr. Edward Atom指着它们：“它们签的是同一份旅行合同。”把两者协调移动，并确保两边都有空间。
story.it: Una coppia Linked arrivò in una stanza senza transito Rift. Dr. Edward Atom indicò entrambi gli atomi: «Hanno firmato lo stesso contratto di viaggio.» Muovi la coppia in modo coordinato e lascia spazio a entrambi.
story.ko: A Linked pair arrived in a chamber with no Rift transit. Dr. Edward Atom pointed at both atoms. “They signed the same travel contract.” Move the pair as a coordinated unit and make sure both sides have room.
story.ru: A Linked pair arrived in a chamber with no Rift transit. Dr. Edward Atom pointed at both atoms. “They signed the same travel contract.” Move the pair as a coordinated unit and make sure both sides have room.

campaign.lesson: Fusion + Rotation refresher: complete the sub-structure, lock it rigid, then rotate it 90° on the pad.

story.en: The Vault brought back Fusion and the Rotation Pad in one calibration test. Dr. Edward Atom rubbed his hands. “Build it, lock it, spin it. Finally, choreography for molecules.” Form the highlighted rigid sub-structure, then use the pad to change its orientation.
story.tr: Kasa Fusion ve Rotation Pad’i tek bir kalibrasyon testinde geri getirdi. Dr. Edward Atom ellerini ovuşturdu. “Kur, kilitle, döndür. Moleküller için koreografi.” Vurgulanan rijit alt yapıyı oluştur, sonra yönünü değiştirmek için platformu kullan.
story.de: Der Tresor brachte Fusion und Rotationsfeld in einem Kalibrierungstest zurück. Dr. Edward Atom rieb sich die Hände. „Bauen, verriegeln, drehen. Molekül-Choreografie.“ Forme die markierte starre Teilstruktur und ändere dann ihre Ausrichtung auf dem Feld.
story.es: La Cámara recuperó Fusión y Plataforma de Rotación en una sola calibración. Dr. Edward Atom se frotó las manos. «Construye, bloquea, gira. Coreografía molecular». Forma la subestructura rígida indicada y usa la plataforma para cambiar su orientación.
story.pt: A Câmara trouxe de volta Fusão e Plataforma de Rotação em um teste de calibração. Dr. Edward Atom esfregou as mãos. “Monte, trave, gire. Coreografia molecular.” Forme a subestrutura rígida indicada e use a plataforma para mudar sua orientação.
story.ja: 保管庫はFusionとRotation Padを同じ較正テストに戻した。Dr. Edward Atomは手をこすった。「組んで、固定して、回す。分子の振り付けだ。」指定の剛体部分構造を作り、パッドで向きを変えよう。
story.fr: La Chambre réunit Fusion et Plateforme de rotation dans un test de calibration. Dr. Edward Atom se frotta les mains : « Construire, verrouiller, tourner. Enfin une chorégraphie moléculaire. » Forme la sous-structure rigide puis change son orientation sur la plateforme.
story.zh: 共振库把Fusion和Rotation Pad放进了同一个校准测试。Dr. Edward Atom搓搓手：“组装、锁定、旋转——分子编舞。”先形成标记的刚性子结构，再用旋转平台改变方向。
story.it: La Camera riportò Fusione e Piattaforma di Rotazione nello stesso test. Dr. Edward Atom si sfregò le mani: «Costruisci, blocca, ruota. Coreografia molecolare.» Forma la sottostruttura rigida e usa la piattaforma per cambiarne l’orientamento.
story.ko: The Vault brought back Fusion and the Rotation Pad in one calibration test. Dr. Edward Atom rubbed his hands. “Build it, lock it, spin it. Finally, choreography for molecules.” Form the highlighted rigid sub-structure, then use the pad to change its orientation.
story.ru: The Vault brought back Fusion and the Rotation Pad in one calibration test. Dr. Edward Atom rubbed his hands. “Build it, lock it, spin it. Finally, choreography for molecules.” Form the highlighted rigid sub-structure, then use the pad to change its orientation.

campaign.lesson: Rift mastery: combine moving-wall timing, one-way flow and fragile impact management without rigid Rift transit.

story.pt: Uma nova trilha de ressonância surge dentro da Câmara. O sinal contorna um novo obstáculo; Dr. Edward Atom marca as paradas seguras antes que a trilha mude novamente. C2H2Br2 se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.

story.ru: A new resonance trace surfaces inside the Vault. The signal bends around a fresh obstruction; Dr. Edward Atom marks the safe stops before the trace shifts again. C2H2Br2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

story.tr: Enzim Kapısı önceki hizalamayı reddedip yeni bir tanıma deseni açıyor. Dr. Null bir faz uyumsuzluğu buluyor; rota dıştan içe yeniden kurulmak zorunda. HNO2 bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: The Enzyme Gate rejects the previous alignment and exposes a new recognition pattern. Dr. Null finds a phase mismatch; the route must be rebuilt from the outside in. HNO2 becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Das Enzym-Tor verwirft die vorige Ausrichtung und legt ein neues Erkennungsmuster frei. Dr. Null entdeckt eine Phasenabweichung; die Route muss von außen nach innen neu aufgebaut werden. HNO2 wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: La Puerta Enzimática rechaza la alineación anterior y revela un nuevo patrón de reconocimiento. Dr. Null encuentra un desfase; la ruta debe reconstruirse de fuera hacia dentro. HNO2 se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: O Portal Enzimático rejeita o alinhamento anterior e revela um novo padrão de reconhecimento. Dr. Null encontra um descompasso de fase; a rota precisa ser refeita de fora para dentro. HNO2 se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.

campaign.lesson: Enzyme Gate + Fragile: gather the biological pieces without exhausting the fragile sample.

story.en: The Vault tightened the corridors and kept both the one-way rule and the fragile sample. “Enzymes are selective,” Dr. Edward Atom said, “and apparently this room is too.” Secure the three simulated requirements, then solve the molecular geometry.
story.tr: Kasa koridorları daralttı; tek yön kuralını ve kırılgan örneği de tuttu. Dr. Edward Atom, “Enzimler seçicidir,” dedi, “görünüşe göre bu oda da öyle.” Üç simülasyon gereksinimini güvenceye al, sonra moleküler geometriyi çöz.
story.de: Der Tresor verengte die Korridore und behielt Einbahnregel und fragile Probe bei. „Enzyme sind selektiv“, sagte Dr. Edward Atom, „und dieser Raum offenbar auch.“ Sichere die drei simulierten Voraussetzungen und löse dann die Molekülgeometrie.
story.es: La Cámara estrechó los pasillos y mantuvo el sentido único y la muestra frágil. «Las enzimas son selectivas», dijo Dr. Edward Atom, «y esta sala también». Asegura los tres requisitos simulados y después resuelve la geometría molecular.
story.pt: A Câmara apertou os corredores e manteve a mão única e a amostra frágil. “Enzimas são seletivas”, disse Dr. Edward Atom, “e esta sala também.” Garanta os três requisitos simulados e então resolva a geometria molecular.
story.ja: 保管庫は通路を狭め、一方通行とFragile試料を残した。Dr. Edward Atomは言った。「酵素は選択的だ。この部屋も同じらしい。」3つの模擬条件を確保してから、分子形状を解こう。
story.fr: La Chambre resserra les couloirs tout en gardant le sens unique et l’échantillon fragile. « Les enzymes sont sélectives, dit Dr. Edward Atom, et cette salle aussi. » Sécurise les trois conditions simulées puis résous la géométrie moléculaire.
story.zh: 共振库收紧了通道，同时保留单向规则和易碎样品。Dr. Edward Atom说：“酶具有选择性，看来这房间也是。”先满足三个模拟条件，再解决分子几何。
story.it: La Camera strinse i corridoi mantenendo senso unico e campione fragile. «Gli enzimi sono selettivi», disse Dr. Edward Atom, «e a quanto pare anche questa stanza.» Assicura i tre requisiti simulati, poi risolvi la geometria molecolare.
story.ko: The Vault tightened the corridors and kept both the one-way rule and the fragile sample. “Enzymes are selective,” Dr. Edward Atom said, “and apparently this room is too.” Secure the three simulated requirements, then solve the molecular geometry.
story.ru: The Vault tightened the corridors and kept both the one-way rule and the fragile sample. “Enzymes are selective,” Dr. Edward Atom said, “and apparently this room is too.” Secure the three simulated requirements, then solve the molecular geometry.

campaign.lesson: Enzyme Gate mastery: combine collection order, One-Way flow and fragile impact control.

story.en: The fifth Enzyme Gate test mixed biological collection with hazardous-looking chemistry. Dr. Edward Atom raised a finger. “The biology layer is simulated; the molecule is real chemistry. Keep those facts separate.” Collect, unlock, then assemble with precision.
story.tr: Beşinci Enzim Kapısı testi biyolojik toplamayı tehlikeli görünümlü kimyayla birleştirdi. Dr. Edward Atom parmağını kaldırdı. “Biyoloji katmanı simülasyon; molekül ise gerçek kimya. Bu ikisini birbirine karıştırma.” Topla, kilidi aç, sonra hassas biçimde birleştir.
story.de: Der fünfte Enzym-Tor-Test verband Bio-Sammeln mit gefährlich wirkender Chemie. Dr. Edward Atom hob einen Finger. „Die Biologie-Ebene ist simuliert; das Molekül gehört zur realen Chemie. Nicht verwechseln.“ Sammeln, entsperren, präzise zusammensetzen.
story.es: La quinta prueba de la Puerta Enzimática mezcló recolección biológica con química de aspecto peligroso. Dr. Edward Atom levantó un dedo. «La capa biológica es simulada; la molécula pertenece a la química real. No las confundas». Recoge, desbloquea y ensambla con precisión.
story.pt: O quinto teste do Portal Enzimático misturou coleta biológica com química de aparência perigosa. Dr. Edward Atom levantou um dedo. “A camada biológica é simulada; a molécula é química real. Não confunda as duas.” Colete, desbloqueie e monte com precisão.
story.ja: 5つ目の酵素ゲート試験では、生体パーツ収集と危険性のある実在化学物質が組み合わされた。Dr. Edward Atomは指を立てた。「生物学レイヤーはシミュレーション、分子は実在の化学だ。混同しないこと。」集めて、解除して、正確に組み立てよう。
story.fr: Le cinquième test de Porte Enzymatique mêla collecte biologique et chimie à l’allure dangereuse. Dr. Edward Atom leva un doigt. « La couche biologique est simulée ; la molécule relève de la chimie réelle. Ne mélange pas les deux. » Collecte, déverrouille, puis assemble avec précision.
story.zh: 第五个酶门测试把生物收集机制与看起来危险的真实化学结合起来。Dr. Edward Atom举起一根手指：“生物层是模拟的；分子属于真实化学。别把两者混为一谈。”收集、解锁，再精确组装。
story.it: Il quinto test della Porta Enzimatica unì raccolta biologica e chimica dall’aspetto pericoloso. Dr. Edward Atom alzò un dito. «Lo strato biologico è simulato; la molecola è chimica reale. Tieni distinti i due concetti.» Raccogli, sblocca e assembla con precisione.
story.ko: The fifth Enzyme Gate test mixed biological collection with hazardous-looking chemistry. Dr. Edward Atom raised a finger. “The biology layer is simulated; the molecule is real chemistry. Keep those facts separate.” Collect, unlock, then assemble with precision.
story.ru: The fifth Enzyme Gate test mixed biological collection with hazardous-looking chemistry. Dr. Edward Atom raised a finger. “The biology layer is simulated; the molecule is real chemistry. Keep those facts separate.” Collect, unlock, then assemble with precision.

campaign.lesson: Enzyme Gate mastery: satisfy the three simulated requirements, unlock the gate and finish the molecule.

story.en: The Vault stopped teaching politely. Four systems woke at once: enzyme collection, ice, fire and a zombie atom. Dr. Edward Atom grinned. “Now the gate wants proof you learned the whole lab.” Collect all three simulated bio requirements, then assemble the real molecular topology.
story.tr: Kasa artık nazikçe öğretmeyi bıraktı. Enzim toplama, buz, ateş ve zombi atom aynı anda uyandı. Dr. Edward Atom sırıttı: “Kapı artık bütün laboratuvarı öğrendiğini kanıtlamanı istiyor.” Üç simülasyon biyolojik gereksinimini topla, sonra gerçek moleküler topolojiyi kur.
story.de: Die Enzym-Meisterprüfung kombiniert mehrere Systeme gleichzeitig. Sammle zuerst Substratfragment, Cofaktor und ATP-Energie im vereinfachten Bio-Modell; beherrsche danach die Gefahren und vollende die echte Molekül-Topologie.
story.es: La prueba maestra de la Puerta Enzimática combina varios sistemas a la vez. Recoge primero el fragmento de sustrato, el cofactor y la energía ATP del modelo biológico simplificado; después domina los peligros y completa la topología molecular real.
story.pt: O teste de domínio do Portal Enzimático combina vários sistemas ao mesmo tempo. Primeiro colete o fragmento de substrato, o cofator e a energia de ATP do modelo biológico simplificado; depois controle os perigos e complete a topologia molecular real.
story.ja: 酵素ゲートのマスター試験では複数の仕組みが同時に重なります。簡略化した生体モデルで基質フラグメント・補因子・ATPエネルギーを集め、危険要素を管理して実際の分子トポロジーを完成させてください。
story.fr: L’épreuve de maîtrise de la Porte Enzymatique combine plusieurs systèmes à la fois. Collecte d’abord le fragment de substrat, le cofacteur et l’énergie ATP du modèle biologique simplifié ; maîtrise ensuite les dangers et termine la topologie moléculaire réelle.
story.zh: 酶门精通测试会同时叠加多种机制。先在简化生物模型中收集底物片段、辅因子和ATP能量，再控制各种危险并完成真实分子拓扑。
story.it: La prova di padronanza della Porta Enzimatica combina più sistemi insieme. Prima raccogli frammento di substrato, cofattore ed energia ATP nel modello biologico semplificato; poi gestisci i pericoli e completa la topologia molecolare reale.
story.ko: The Vault stopped teaching politely. Four systems woke at once: enzyme collection, ice, fire and a zombie atom. Dr. Edward Atom grinned. “Now the gate wants proof you learned the whole lab.” Collect all three simulated bio requirements, then assemble the real molecular topology.

story.tr: Kasa molekülü değiştirdi ama dört sistemli baskıyı korudu. Dr. Edward Atom tahtaya vurdu: “Güzel. Yeni kimya, aynı acımasız mantık.” Hareketli tehlikelerin kontrolünü kaybetmeden topla, kilidi aç ve birleştir.
story.de: Die Enzym-Meisterprüfung kombiniert mehrere Systeme gleichzeitig. Sammle zuerst Substratfragment, Cofaktor und ATP-Energie im vereinfachten Bio-Modell; beherrsche danach die Gefahren und vollende die echte Molekül-Topologie.
story.es: La prueba maestra de la Puerta Enzimática combina varios sistemas a la vez. Recoge primero el fragmento de sustrato, el cofactor y la energía ATP del modelo biológico simplificado; después domina los peligros y completa la topología molecular real.
story.pt: O teste de domínio do Portal Enzimático combina vários sistemas ao mesmo tempo. Primeiro colete o fragmento de substrato, o cofator e a energia de ATP do modelo biológico simplificado; depois controle os perigos e complete a topologia molecular real.
story.ja: 酵素ゲートのマスター試験では複数の仕組みが同時に重なります。簡略化した生体モデルで基質フラグメント・補因子・ATPエネルギーを集め、危険要素を管理して実際の分子トポロジーを完成させてください。

story.en: The first helix signal flickered into view. Dr. Edward Atom grinned: “We are borrowing DNA’s pairing logic, not pretending this grid is a real chromosome.” The Bio Assembly chamber uses a simplified DNA-inspired puzzle model. Collect the A–T pair, the C–G pair and the sugar–phosphate backbone fragment first; then open the assembly field and finish the real target molecule. Real DNA is vastly more complex and is not built atom by atom this way.
story.tr: İlk sarmal sinyali belirdi. Dr. Edward Atom sırıttı: “DNA’nın eşleşme mantığından esinleniyoruz; bu ızgarayı gerçek kromozom sanmıyoruz.” Bio Assembly odası DNA’dan esinlenen sadeleştirilmiş bir bulmaca modeli kullanıyor. Önce A–T çifti, C–G çifti ve şeker–fosfat omurga parçasını topla; ardından montaj alanını aç ve gerçek hedef molekülü tamamla. Gerçek DNA çok daha karmaşıktır ve atom atom bu şekilde kurulmaz.
story.de: Die Bio-Assembly-Kammer nutzt ein vereinfachtes, von DNA inspiriertes Puzzlemodell. Sammle zuerst A–T-Paar, C–G-Paar und Zucker-Phosphat-Rückgratfragment; öffne dann das Montagefeld und vollende das echte Zielmolekül. Reale DNA ist viel komplexer und wird nicht Atom für Atom so aufgebaut.
story.es: La cámara Bio Assembly usa un modelo de puzle simplificado inspirado en el ADN. Recoge primero el par A–T, el par C–G y el fragmento de esqueleto azúcar–fosfato; después abre el campo de montaje y completa la molécula objetivo real. El ADN real es mucho más complejo y no se construye átomo a átomo de esta manera.
story.pt: A câmara Bio Assembly usa um modelo de puzzle simplificado inspirado no DNA. Colete primeiro o par A–T, o par C–G e o fragmento da espinha dorsal açúcar–fosfato; depois abra o campo de montagem e complete a molécula real. O DNA real é muito mais complexo e não é montado átomo por átomo dessa forma.
story.ja: Bio AssemblyはDNAに着想を得た簡略化パズルモデルです。まずA–Tペア、C–Gペア、糖–リン酸骨格フラグメントを集め、組立フィールドを開いて実在する目標分子を完成させます。実際のDNAははるかに複雑で、このように原子を1個ずつ並べて作るものではありません。
story.fr: La chambre Bio Assembly utilise un modèle de puzzle simplifié inspiré de l’ADN. Collecte d’abord la paire A–T, la paire C–G et le fragment de squelette sucre–phosphate ; ouvre ensuite le champ d’assemblage et termine la vraie molécule cible. L’ADN réel est bien plus complexe et ne se construit pas atome par atome de cette façon.
story.zh: Bio Assembly采用受DNA启发的简化拼图模型。先收集A–T碱基对、C–G碱基对和糖–磷酸骨架片段，再开启组装区域并完成真实目标分子。真实DNA要复杂得多，并不是以这种方式逐个原子搭建的。
story.it: La camera Bio Assembly usa un modello di puzzle semplificato ispirato al DNA. Raccogli prima la coppia A–T, la coppia C–G e il frammento dello scheletro zucchero–fosfato; poi apri il campo di assemblaggio e completa la vera molecola bersaglio. Il DNA reale è molto più complesso e non viene costruito atomo per atomo in questo modo.

Real DNA is vastly more complex and is not built atom by atom this way.

Real DNA is vastly more complex and is not built atom by atom this way.

story.tr: Dr. Edward Atom tamamlanan eşleşme ekranını gösterdi: “Bu sana giriş hakkı verir, zafer değil. Molekül hâlâ doğru olmak zorunda.” Bio Assembly odası DNA’dan esinlenen sadeleştirilmiş bir bulmaca modeli kullanıyor. Önce A–T çifti, C–G çifti ve şeker–fosfat omurga parçasını topla; ardından montaj alanını aç ve gerçek hedef molekülü tamamla. Gerçek DNA çok daha karmaşıktır ve atom atom bu şekilde kurulmaz.
story.de: Die Bio-Assembly-Kammer nutzt ein vereinfachtes, von DNA inspiriertes Puzzlemodell. Sammle zuerst A–T-Paar, C–G-Paar und Zucker-Phosphat-Rückgratfragment; öffne dann das Montagefeld und vollende das echte Zielmolekül. Reale DNA ist viel komplexer und wird nicht Atom für Atom so aufgebaut.
story.es: La cámara Bio Assembly usa un modelo de puzle simplificado inspirado en el ADN. Recoge primero el par A–T, el par C–G y el fragmento de esqueleto azúcar–fosfato; después abre el campo de montaje y completa la molécula objetivo real. El ADN real es mucho más complejo y no se construye átomo a átomo de esta manera.
story.pt: A câmara Bio Assembly usa um modelo de puzzle simplificado inspirado no DNA. Colete primeiro o par A–T, o par C–G e o fragmento da espinha dorsal açúcar–fosfato; depois abra o campo de montagem e complete a molécula real. O DNA real é muito mais complexo e não é montado átomo por átomo dessa forma.
story.ja: Bio AssemblyはDNAに着想を得た簡略化パズルモデルです。まずA–Tペア、C–Gペア、糖–リン酸骨格フラグメントを集め、組立フィールドを開いて実在する目標分子を完成させます。実際のDNAははるかに複雑で、このように原子を1個ずつ並べて作るものではありません。
story.fr: La chambre Bio Assembly utilise un modèle de puzzle simplifié inspiré de l’ADN. Collecte d’abord la paire A–T, la paire C–G et le fragment de squelette sucre–phosphate ; ouvre ensuite le champ d’assemblage et termine la vraie molécule cible. L’ADN réel est bien plus complexe et ne se construit pas atome par atome de cette façon.
story.zh: Bio Assembly采用受DNA启发的简化拼图模型。先收集A–T碱基对、C–G碱基对和糖–磷酸骨架片段，再开启组装区域并完成真实目标分子。真实DNA要复杂得多，并不是以这种方式逐个原子搭建的。
story.it: La camera Bio Assembly usa un modello di puzzle semplificato ispirato al DNA. Raccogli prima la coppia A–T, la coppia C–G e il frammento dello scheletro zucchero–fosfato; poi apri il campo di assemblaggio e completa la vera molecola bersaglio. Il DNA reale è molto più complesso e non viene costruito atomo per atomo in questo modo.

story.tr: Bio Assembly odası moleküler haritasını yeniden çiziyor. Dr. Null bir faz uyumsuzluğu buluyor; rota dıştan içe yeniden kurulmak zorunda. CBrClFIO bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: The Bio Assembly chamber redraws its molecular map. Dr. Null finds a phase mismatch; the route must be rebuilt from the outside in. CBrClFIO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Die Bio-Assembly-Kammer zeichnet ihre Molekülkarte neu. Dr. Null entdeckt eine Phasenabweichung; die Route muss von außen nach innen neu aufgebaut werden. CBrClFIO wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: La cámara Bio Assembly redibuja su mapa molecular. Dr. Null encuentra un desfase; la ruta debe reconstruirse de fuera hacia dentro. CBrClFIO se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: A câmara Bio Assembly redesenha seu mapa molecular. Dr. Null encontra um descompasso de fase; a rota precisa ser refeita de fora para dentro. CBrClFIO se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: Bio Assemblyチャンバーが分子マップを書き換える。 Dr. Nullが位相のずれを見つけ、ルートを外側から内側へ組み直す必要が生じる。 CBrClFIOがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: La chambre Bio Assembly redessine sa carte moléculaire. Dr. Null détecte un décalage de phase ; la route doit être reconstruite de l’extérieur vers l’intérieur. CBrClFIO devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: Bio Assembly舱重新绘制了分子地图。 Dr. Null发现相位不匹配；路线必须从外向内重新构建。 CBrClFIO成为稳定这一阶段的关键。

story.zh: Grand Synthesis开启了另一条高能组装通道。 Dr. Null发现相位不匹配；路线必须从外向内重新构建。 C3H5BrClFO成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Grand Synthesis apre un nuovo canale di assemblaggio ad alta energia. Dr. Null trova uno sfasamento; il percorso deve essere ricostruito dall’esterno verso l’interno. C3H5BrClFO diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: Grand Synthesis opens another high-energy assembly lane. Dr. Null finds a phase mismatch; the route must be rebuilt from the outside in. C3H5BrClFO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: Grand Synthesis opens another high-energy assembly lane. Dr. Null finds a phase mismatch; the route must be rebuilt from the outside in. C3H5BrClFO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

campaign.lesson: Grand Synthesis: coordinate three stabilized molecular fragments, rotate them as rigid units, respect directional flow, and complete the final molecular topology wherever it fits.

story.tr: Grand Synthesis yeni bir yüksek enerjili birleştirme hattı açıyor. Uyuyan bir kanal açılıyor ve hangi koridorun önce kullanılacağını değiştiriyor. C3H5ClBrI bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: Grand Synthesis opens another high-energy assembly lane. A dormant channel wakes up and changes which corridor matters first. C3H5ClBrI becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Grand Synthesis öffnet eine weitere Hochenergie-Montagespur. Ein ruhender Kanal erwacht und verändert, welcher Korridor zuerst zählt. C3H5ClBrI wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Grand Synthesis abre otra vía de ensamblaje de alta energía. Un canal inactivo despierta y cambia qué corredor importa primero. C3H5ClBrI se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Grand Synthesis abre outra rota de montagem de alta energia. Um canal adormecido desperta e muda qual corredor deve vir primeiro. C3H5ClBrI se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: Grand Synthesisが新たな高エネルギー組立レーンを開く。 休止していた経路が起動し、最初に使うべき通路が変わる。 C3H5ClBrIがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Grand Synthesis ouvre une nouvelle voie d’assemblage à haute énergie. Un canal dormant se réveille et change le couloir à privilégier en premier. C3H5ClBrI devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: Grand Synthesis开启了另一条高能组装通道。 一条休眠通道被唤醒，改变了首先需要处理的走廊。 C3H5ClBrI成为稳定这一阶段的关键。
story.it: Grand Synthesis apre un nuovo canale di assemblaggio ad alta energia. Un canale inattivo si riattiva e cambia quale corridoio conta per primo. C3H5ClBrI diventa la chiave che stabilizza questa fase.
story.ko: Grand Synthesis opens another high-energy assembly lane. A dormant channel wakes up and changes which corridor matters first. C3H5ClBrI becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.ru: Grand Synthesis opens another high-energy assembly lane. A dormant channel wakes up and changes which corridor matters first. C3H5ClBrI becomes the key that stabilizes this step.

story.tr: Grand Synthesis yeni bir yüksek enerjili birleştirme hattı açıyor. Moxy ikinci bir yankı yakalıyor ve yaklaşma sırasını tamamen değiştiriyor. C3H5ClFIO bu adımı sabitleyen anahtar oluyor.
story.en: Grand Synthesis opens another high-energy assembly lane. Moxy detects a second echo, forcing a different order of approach. C3H5ClFIO becomes the key that stabilizes this step.
story.de: Grand Synthesis öffnet eine weitere Hochenergie-Montagespur. Moxy erkennt ein zweites Echo und erzwingt damit eine andere Reihenfolge der Annäherung. C3H5ClFIO wird zum Schlüssel, der diesen Schritt stabilisiert.
story.es: Grand Synthesis abre otra vía de ensamblaje de alta energía. Moxy detecta un segundo eco, obligando a cambiar el orden de aproximación. C3H5ClFIO se convierte en la clave que estabiliza este paso.
story.pt: Grand Synthesis abre outra rota de montagem de alta energia. Moxy detecta um segundo eco, obrigando a mudar a ordem de aproximação. C3H5ClFIO se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.
story.ja: Grand Synthesisが新たな高エネルギー組立レーンを開く。 Moxyが第二の反響を検出し、接近の順番を変えざるを得なくなる。 C3H5ClFIOがこの段階を安定させる鍵になる。
story.fr: Grand Synthesis ouvre une nouvelle voie d’assemblage à haute énergie. Moxy détecte un second écho, imposant un nouvel ordre d’approche. C3H5ClFIO devient la clé qui stabilise cette étape.
story.zh: Grand Synthesis开启了另一条高能组装通道。 Moxy探测到第二道回声，迫使接近顺序发生改变。 C3H5ClFIO成为稳定这一阶段的关键。

story.pt: Grand Synthesis abre outra rota de montagem de alta energia. A próxima trava só abre quando os átomos entram em um novo ritmo espacial. C3H5BrFI se torna a chave que estabiliza esta etapa.

story.es: La Señal X ya no parece un eco lejano. Cuatro módulos rígidos entran a la vez. Dr. Edward Atom: «Desde aquí, el laboratorio no perdona una mala planificación». Guía y gira los módulos hasta formar 2-bromo-1,1-dicloro-3-yodobutano (C₄H₆Cl₂BrI).

story.it: Il corridoio X-Origin si stringe attorno a quattro moduli rigidi. Dr. Edward Atom: «A questa profondità, ricordare le regole fa parte del puzzle.» Pianifica ogni arresto e forma 2,4-dibromo-1-cloro-1,3-diiodobutano (C₄H₅ClBr₂I₂).

story.de: Der X-Origin-Korridor schließt sich um vier starre Module. Dr. Edward Atom: „Hier unten gehört das Erinnern der Regeln zum Puzzle.“ Plane jeden Stopp und baue 1-brom-2,4-difluor-1,2,3-triiodbutan (C₄H₄BrF₂I₃).
story.es: El corredor X-Origin se cierra alrededor de cuatro módulos rígidos. Dr. Edward Atom: «A esta profundidad, recordar las reglas también forma parte del puzzle». Planifica cada parada y forma 1-bromo-2,4-difluoro-1,2,3-triyodobutano (C₄H₄BrF₂I₃).
story.pt: O corredor X-Origin se fecha em torno de quatro módulos rígidos. Dr. Edward Atom: “Nesta profundidade, lembrar as regras também faz parte do puzzle.” Planeje cada parada e forme 1-bromo-2,4-difluoro-1,2,3-triiodobutano (C₄H₄BrF₂I₃).
story.ja: X-Origin回廊が4つの固定モジュールを囲むように狭まる。Dr. Edward Atom：「ここではルールを覚えていること自体がパズルだ。」すべての停止位置を計画し、1-bromo-2,4-difluoro-1,2,3-triiodobutane（多ハロゲン化ブタン）（C₄H₄BrF₂I₃）を完成させよう。
story.fr: Le couloir X-Origin se resserre autour de quatre modules rigides. Dr. Edward Atom : « À cette profondeur, se souvenir des règles fait partie du puzzle. » Planifie chaque arrêt et forme 1-bromo-2,4-difluoro-1,2,3-triiodobutane (C₄H₄BrF₂I₃).
story.zh: X-Origin通道在四个刚性模块周围收紧。Dr. Edward Atom说：“到了这里，记住规则本身就是谜题的一部分。”规划每一次停靠，完成1-bromo-2,4-difluoro-1,2,3-triiodobutane（多卤代丁烷）（C₄H₄BrF₂I₃）。
story.it: Il corridoio X-Origin si stringe attorno a quattro moduli rigidi. Dr. Edward Atom: «A questa profondità, ricordare le regole fa parte del puzzle.» Pianifica ogni arresto e forma 1-bromo-2,4-difluoro-1,2,3-triiodobutano (C₄H₄BrF₂I₃).

campaign.lesson: Elite X-Origin: four rigid modules, deliberate Rotation, route-active One-Way flow, and no assumed shortcut. The final also uses an active Fragile anchor.

story.tr: X-Origin çekirdeği son kez tek ve kararlı bir darbe yayıyor. C4F10O, Kasa’nın kapanış araştırma deseni. Bu düzen kilitlendiğinde Rezonans Kasası mühürlenecek ve X Sinyali’nin izi sona erecek.
story.en: The X-Origin core emits one final, steady pulse. C4F10O is the Vault’s closing research pattern. When it locks, the Resonance Vault will seal and the X Signal trail will end.
story.de: Der X-Origin-Kern sendet einen letzten, gleichmäßigen Impuls. C4F10O ist das abschließende Forschungsmuster des Tresors. Sobald es einrastet, wird der Resonanz-Tresor versiegelt und die Spur des X-Signals endet.
story.es: El núcleo X-Origin emite un último pulso estable. C4F10O es el patrón de investigación final de la Bóveda. Cuando encaje, la Bóveda de Resonancia quedará sellada y terminará el rastro de la Señal X.
story.pt: O núcleo X-Origin emite um último pulso estável. C4F10O é o padrão final de pesquisa da Câmara. Quando ele travar, a Câmara de Ressonância será selada e a trilha do Sinal X terminará.
story.ja: X-Originコアが最後の安定したパルスを放つ。C4F10Oは保管庫を閉じる最後の研究パターンだ。これが固定されれば共鳴保管庫は封印され、Xシグナルの軌跡は終わる。
story.fr: Le noyau X-Origin émet une ultime impulsion stable. C4F10O est le motif de recherche qui doit fermer la Chambre. Une fois verrouillé, la Chambre de Résonance sera scellée et la trace du Signal X prendra fin.
story.zh: X-Origin核心发出最后一次稳定脉冲。C4F10O是宝库的最终研究图案。它一旦锁定，共振库就会封闭，X信号的轨迹也将终止。
story.it: Il nucleo X-Origin emette un ultimo impulso stabile. C4F10O è lo schema di ricerca conclusivo della Camera. Quando si bloccherà, la Camera di Risonanza verrà sigillata e la traccia del Segnale X terminerà.
story.ko: The X-Origin core emits one final, steady pulse. C4F10O is the Vault’s closing research pattern. When it locks, the Resonance Vault will seal and the X Signal trail will end.
